Work with your GM to settle on a choice of patron you like that fits the world of your game.

entries.subclassFeature: Plague Doctor, Bringer of Sorrow or Succor|Warlock|PHB|Plague Doctor|EchoesOfRenaissance|1|EchoesOfRenaissance

subclassFeature.name: Plague Doctor, Bringer of Sorrow or Succor
entries: When you choose this patron at Level 1, you gain the following items: your plague mask, linen robes, and your wooden cane. These items are considered magical.

items: The mask and robes grant you resistance to poison damage if you do not already have it, and you have advantage on rolls against the {@condition poisoned} condition or diseases.

The herbs in the beak of your mask not only block out the miasma; they can also heighten your senses. Choose one of the following skills: Wisdom ({@skill Perception}), Wisdom ({@skill Insight}), or Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}). You have advantage on checks with this skill.

You gain proficiency with the {@item Herbalist's kit} if you did not already have it from a background. If you spend 1 hour, you can make satchels filled with lavender, camphor, ambergris, labdanum, and myrrh. Each of these satchels grants the bearer resistance to necrotic and poison damage for a day before the effects wear off. You can create a number of these equal to your Charisma modifier in 1 hour.
Your mask also induces fear in the sick and healthy, as your presence has become synonymous with the spread of Black Death. You have advantage on Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) rolls.

entries: Your cane is made of pure Bursera graveolens, also known as Palo Santo (‘holy stick'). It is a finesse weapon, deals {@damage 1d6} bludgeoning damage on a hit, and it can be used as your Pact Weapon. Before you make an attack with this weapon, you may use a bonus action to imbue the attack with an extra effect. You can do this a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier before you take a long rest:

items.name: Sap:
entries: {@b } Add an extra {@damage 2d6} necrotic damage to your hit.

items.name: Diminish:
entries: {@b } On a hit, in addition to the damage from the cane, when the creature is hit by an attack roll, it is done at advantage until the start of their next turn.

items.name: Sicken:
entries: {@b } On a hit, in addition to the damage from the cane, the target must make a Constitution saving throw or be stricken with illness. They gain the {@condition poisoned} condition until they take a short or long rest.

items.name: Miasmatic Blow:
entries: {@b } On a hit, in addition to the damage from the cane, a poisonous exhalation erupts from the cane, causing a 15 ft. radius cloud of vomit-inducing air, obscuring others' sight and causing them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they take {@damage 1d6} poison damage and become {@condition incapacitated} as they begin retching uncontrollably. They may repeat the saving throw at the beginning of their next turn. On a successful save, they may move out of the poisonous space and take no damage.

subclassFeature.name: Expanded Spell List
entries: You learn the following spells when you reach the designated Warlock level. They are warlock spells for you. These spells do not count against the number of spells you know.

entries.caption: Plague Doctor Spells
rows: 1st
{@spell detect poison and disease}, {@spell doctor's sense|EchoesOfRenaissance}
3rd
{@spell deadly embrace|EchoesOfRenaissance}, {@spell ray of enfeeblement}
5th
{@spell dreamcatcher|EchoesOfRenaissance}, {@spell speak with dead}
7th
{@spell cursed link|EchoesOfRenaissance}, {@spell blight}
9th
{@spell contagion}, {@spell insect plague}

subclassFeature.name: Written in Blood
entries: When you extract blood–that of a patient or an enemy–you can extract some information from the victim. Perform a ritual which lasts 15 minutes, requiring the blood of the target as an ingredient, and you gain the following abilities:

items: You gain advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) checks related to this target.
You gain advantage on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}, {@skill Insight}) or Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks related to tracking the target.
You learn the creature type and their afflictions, if any.
You learn if the target is a higher level than you.

subclassFeature.name: Deathly Pallor
entries: Your ability to instill fear in the hearts of the populace has heightened. You can now cast {@spell fear} once per day without using a spell slot. It does not count against the number of spells you know.

subclassFeature.name: Dans Cadaverous
entries: In the midst of an epidemic, your ability to discern those who will live and those who will die has become crystal clear. You read the eyes, sagging limbs, and the congealed sweat on the brows of the sick, and gain some insight into the future. You gain the use of the {@spell divination} spell as a ritual, which you can perform once per day if you are within a quarter mile of an outbreak. This does not count against your number of known warlock spells.

items: You may cast either {@spell contagion} or {@spell cloudkill} once per day without a spell slot (Choose 1). It is counted as a warlock spell and does not count against the number of spells you know.

You gain the ability to move effortlessly through the squalor and haze of the baneful and contagious. You can teleport within lightly obscured or heavily obscured spaces up to 60 ft. It does not count against your movement. Moving amongst crowds does not count as difficult terrain for you.
You are now immune to poison.

entries: Your Palo Santo attacks become more powerful.

items.name: Sap:
entries: {@b } Add an extra {@damage 4d6} necrotic damage to your hit in addition to the damage from the cane.

items.name: Diminish:
entries: {@b } On a hit, in addition to the damage from the cane, when the creature is hit by an attack roll, it is done at advantage until the start of your next turn.

items.name: Sicken:
entries: {@b } On a hit, in addition to the damage from the cane, the target must make a Constitution saving throw or be stricken with illness. In addition to being {@condition poisoned}, the target also gains two levels of {@condition exhaustion}.

items.name: Miasmatic Blow:
entries: {@b } It now causes a 20-foot-radius area of sickening ‘bad air.' It also now does {@damage 3d6} poison damage.

subclassFeature.name: Visioni dal Sangue
entries: Your ability to gain information from spilled blood and gore reaches unsettling heights. You now can briefly see the location of a creature whose blood you have spilled as part of a ritual. If that creature is no longer living, you are able to see their final moments. It is up to GM discretion how much is shown in those moments. You know their exact level in relation to yours (instead of just knowing if they are higher). You have advantage on attack rolls or ability checks against the target, and they have disadvantage on rolls against you.

subclassFeature.name: Plague Bringer
entries: You become the harbinger of the plague–your very footfalls become the deciding point of where the plague may spread or cease. Choose one of the following final forms:

subclassFeature.name: Doom Sower/Presage of Hope
entries: As a bonus action, you can extend your robes, giving yourself a flying speed of 60 ft. as well as a larger aura of terror, or calm if you so choose. Creatures you choose within 90 ft. of you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be under either the {@spell calm emotions} or {@spell fear} spell. Those affected by the {@spell fear} side of this ability take {@damage 8d6} necrotic damage if you choose to further their despair; those affected by the {@spell calm emotions} side of this ability are granted {@damage 4d6} healing or are under the effects of the {@spell beacon of hope} spell (your choice). You can do this ability once per day.

subclassFeature.name: Verminus Maximus
entries: As a bonus action, you may transform into a host of rats or similar disease-carrying vermin. You can swarm a number of creatures of your choice equal to your Charisma modifier in a 20-foot-radius sphere. Each of these creatures takes {@damage 4d8} piercing damage and {@damage 4d8} necrotic damage. In addition, they must make Wisdom saving throws or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute (they may repeat the save at the start of each of their turns). On your next turn, you can move your area of effect, and then you return to your normal form at the end of that turn. You can use this ability once per day.

subclassFeature.name: Masque of the Red Death
entries: Once per day, you can choose a target within 30 feet. As a bonus action, you may remove your mask and reveal the plague's true face to that target. If the target fails a Constitution saving throw, they take {@damage 8d10 + 40} necrotic damage. If this brings the target to 0, they are instantly killed. You can put your mask back on as part of your free action.

subclassFeature.name: School of the Inkwielder
entries: Ink is thicker than blood and sometimes deadlier than acid or poison when used in the right way. Some are able to fuse an ordinary ink with the power of the Weave and fill it with arcane energy, making bargains with creatures and borrowing their powers for greater deeds than most adventurers are capable of. The ones that wield such an ink have held power in many realms for a long time. Mehmed Siyahqalam, the Black Pen, was one of the greatest examples of such creatures, or Machiavelli, with all the power he held over parchments or papers to influence the world around him.

Pupils of the Inkwielder school get their power from the bargains they make with many different types of creatures. Rather than regular summoners, they use the echo of the creature to avoid unnecessary enmities with similar spells, and their summons are usually much more powerful than mere familiars.

subclassFeature.name: Ink of Power
entries: Your spellbook, and your connection with it, is different from most wizards'. You can use your ink in a special way. You can strike a bargain with certain creature types in exchange for summoning them in times of need.

The creature type can be: djinni, dragon, elemental, fey, fiend, and monstrosity. Its size must be large or smaller, and it must be able to understand that it is entering into a complicated bargain: creatures with Intelligence scores of 3 or lower cannot be targeted. Check out the table below for a creature suited for a bargain and other needed information.

colLabels: Maximum Challenge Rating of the Creature
Minimum Spell Slot Level Needed to Summon

entries: When you strike a bargain with the creature, you can copy its essence to your spellbook. It requires 25 gd and 1 hour to inscribe it for each CR above 1. When you do so, you have the statblock of the creature. You can summon the creature with the spell slot depicted in the table above.

When you summon the creature as an action, it appears within 30 ft. of you in an unoccupied space. It follows your orders given to them by bonus actions. The creature can stay out of your spellbook for a number of minutes equal to the level of the spell used to summon it (minimum of 1).
You can make bargains with as many creatures as you want, but for a creature to be able to be summoned, you must prepare a creature just like a spell.

Creatures with Challenge Rating equal to 2 or below count as half of a spell's worth against your ability to prepare spells. For example, you can prepare a creature with a CR 1 and a CR 1/4, and they would count as if you prepared one spell.
When the creature dies or its time is up, it vanishes and can't be summoned again until you finish a short or long rest.

You can summon more than one creature as long as their combined CR does not exceed your maximum CR column of the table above. For example, at Level 4 you can have two creatures summoned at the same time with 1/2 Challenge Ratings.

entries.name: The Other Method of Bargaining
entries: The original method of bargains is copying the essence of a creature with their consent. As an optional rule, you can also bind a creature directly to your spellbook if you are able to convince the creature. When you do so, the creature's soul itself is bound to your spellbook, and you summon that creature when you summon. If you do so, the creature's duration spent out of the spellbook is doubled.
You can release such a creature by conducting a 1-minute ritual.

What the creatures require in order for their essence to be put into the bargain is up to the Game Master. There are some suggestions for generic types of creatures, but the Game Master has the final word.
Giving out the essence gives that creature these benefits:

items: You have disadvantage on attack rolls against that creature (Not the type. For example, if you make a bargain with an imp, this benefit works only against that imp, not other imps in general).
The creature has advantage on saving throws that were forced by you.

entries: The table below shows what the creatures may demand upon copying their essence or being directly bound to your spellbook.

rows: Djinni
Spreading dark whispers about a believer with a strong heart.
They are to be released after a month of service, and they must be provided with a body they could possess.
Dragon
A precious gem.
They are to be released after a week of service, and they must be paid heavily.
Elemental
A magic item of at least uncommon rarity and connected with elements.
For a year of service, they require a magical item (rare at least) that possibly produces power connected with elements, such as flame tongue.
Fey
Possibly something ridiculous like “Bring me gloves that were worn by a singer” or something unnecessarily important, “The one secret to change the world.”
They require long-term tasks that are probably annoying to complete, incredibly ridiculous, or unnecessarily hard.
Fiend
An object that carries a person's soul.
Depending on the duration, they require a soul for each week.
Monstrosity
Probably a large supply of food or complex items that they would require in hunting, surviving in the wilds.
A long term pact that would include bringing them food, supplies, helping them in their hunts or securing their territory.

entries: These methods can be suggested for bargaining:

items: Helping the creature when it is in need.
Summoning one through spells and rituals.
Acquiring one from another spellbook or ancient manuscripts.

subclassFeature.name: The Familiar Ink
entries: You learn the {@spell find familiar} spell and add it to your spellbook. Its casting time is 10 minutes for you. If you already have the spell in your spellbook, you can add another 1st-level conjuration spell to your spellbook.

subclassFeature.name: Ritualistic Summon
entries: When you strike a bargain with a creature, you can summon one as a ritual even if you don't have it prepared. The ritual takes 10 minutes.

subclassFeature.name: Benefits of the Bargain
entries: When you summon a creature you made a bargain with, you both gain temporary hit points equal to your wizard level. If you expend a spell slot as a bonus action, you can refresh the temporary hit points.

subclassFeature.name: Borrowing Ability
entries: At 14th level, when you summon a creature, you can choose one of their Ability Scores, and for the next minute, you can replace your Ability Score with the chosen one. Any changes affect you accordingly. For example, if you change your Constitution score to a higher one, you'd have more hit points (based on average: for d8s take 5, for instance). If you have any current hit points missing, reduce the missing hit points from your newly calculated hit points maximum. When you transform back, apply the same conditions on your current hit points.

entries.name: Being a Mendicant
entries: The streets have always been your home. Amidst the shadows of buildings and tall towers, you know where the winds blow and bells echo. Whispers find you because you know exactly where to stand. You know exactly where not to talk. You hide in plain sight, people easily underestimate you, and you always know how to get away with situations.

entries.name: How to Play?
entries: You will collect coins, whispers, and information in urban areas; you will advance your network, having people bring you the collective information and secrets.

entries.name: Prerequisites
entries: In order to start a Profession as a Mendicant, you must have a Charisma score of at least 13 and proficiency in {@skill Deception} or {@skill Performance} skills.

entries.name: Climbing the Ranks
entries: You gain PEX through the activities listed beyond, but it is up to the GM to award PEX for other possible activities that are not listed.

entries.caption: Climbing the Ranks
rows: Collecting at least 5 gd in a day
5 PEX
Collecting at least 10 gd in a day
15 PEX
Collecting at least 25 gd in a day
30 PEX
Learning a secret of an important labor-class individual
5 PEX
Learning a secret of an important merchant-class individual
10 PEX
Learning a secret of an important rich-class individual
15 PEX
Learning a secret of a noble or an equally important individual
25 PEX
Taking contracts and completing from a faction (for example learning the entrance of a thieves' guild hideout for a mercenary band)
X{@sup *} PEX
footnotes: {@b {@sup *}Note:} The PEX reward for this activity is dependent on how hard it is, but must be rewarded with at least 10 PEX.

entries.name: Apprentice Mendicant
entries: {@i Rank One}

As an apprentice mendicant, you roam the streets while collecting whispers, secrets, and coins from people. You know how to get on their good sides, or at least where to stand to catch what they are saying.
You can purchase the following abilities with PEX:

entries.name: Journeyman Mendicant
entries: {@i Rank Two | 300 PEX}

Your time spent in the streets has made you an adept mendicant. Instead of doing all the dirty work with your hands, you now have a way of establishing a network and conducting operations. Apprentices follow your lead, and every now and then news reaches you first. You are the source of some gossip and control the flow of whispers in some streets.
You can purchase the following abilities with PEX:

entries.name: Expert Mendicant
entries: {@i Rank Three | 1000 PEX}

You are now the king or queen of the beggars; you hear every whisper uttered on the streets and even birds' singing reach your ears eventually. The coins put in beggars' cups flow your way. You have an eye and ear on each street, maybe even in each store or tavern. You do not only listen now–you talk and whisper while you decide what is true for the local folk and travelers.
You can purchase the following abilities with PEX:

entries.name: Master Mendicant
entries: {@i Rank Four | 5000 PEX}

You are known as a kingmaker now. Streets talk through you. Not a single word of gossip has ever reached anyone's ear before your treatment or guidance. Nobles and kings know not to cross you, as they realize you can control what is truth and what is not.
You can purchase the following abilities with PEX:

entries.name: Vox Viarum, Voice of the Streets
Roaming the Streets
entries: You spend a week keeping a low profile, traveling through the streets, and collecting some coins. The GM determines what skill could be applied to the Charisma check. If you roll 9 or below, you could get in trouble at the discretion of the GM. Check out the table Climbing the Ranks for related PEX rewards.

entries.caption: Roaming the Streets
rows: 1 gd
5 gd
10 gd
20 gd
30 gd

entries.name: Buying Off Local Law Enforcement
entries: You make your way through the known individuals from the local law enforcement - for example, city guards who might be more open to your business endeavor. If you succeed on a DC 20 Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check, they do not bother you for the next week or month. Each 5 gd spent lowers the DC by 2 to a minimum of 10 and you gain 15 PEX if you succeed.

entries.name: Underground Contact
entries: You can spend one workweek and 25 gd to learn the places you can buy or fence some unique and possibly illegal items or meet with "interesting" people. Roll a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) or Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check against DC 10. On a success, you meet one of the black-market tradesmen. Work with your GM to determine their proficiency, their items, attitude, and other important details. Once you establish a contact, you can revisit this downtime activity with a DC 10 {@skill Persuasion} check to have an arrangement with the determined contact, for example for information or a specific item. The details are determined by the GM.

prerequisite.other: proficiency in at least one martial weapon

entries.name: Being a Condottiero
entries: You sell your sword in exchange for coins and secure your agreements under a contract. Your combat prowess and experience in battle will help you to change the tides in wars and inflict fear in your enemies. Your life is to live and die by the sword, whenever fate grants it.

entries.name: How to Play?
entries: Filling contracts and fulfilling them, usually jobs that require combat prowess, martial talent, leadership, courage, and similar qualities.

entries.name: Prerequisites
entries: You must be proficient in at least one martial weapon, and your Strength or Dexterity score must be 13.

entries.name: Climbing the Ranks
entries: You must complete contracts in order to earn PEX. Work with your GM to put contracts and their binding conditions into your adventures, or set them during downtimes, depending on the game's needs.

entries.caption: Climbing the Ranks
rows: A day's contract
5 PEX
Weekly contract
15 PEX

20 PEX
Seasonal contract

10 PEX
Participating in a campaign

entries.name: Apprentice Condottiero
entries: {@i Rank One}
You have recently started to sell your services to those in need of a martial professional. People start to hear your name, and you start to build a fame and fortune for yourself.
You can purchase the following abilities with PEX:

entries.name: Journeyman Condottiero
entries: {@i Rank Two | 300 PEX}

You started to make a name for yourself. Your time in battles, on missions, and more has honed your skills and increased your prowess. Many contracts come your way, but you are in a place to actually choose them.
You can purchase the following abilities with PEX:

entries.name: Expert Condottiero
entries: {@i Rank Three | 1000 PEX}
You made a name for yourself among the mercenaries of the realm. You have shown strength, courage and resolve.
You can purchase the following abilities with PEX:

entries.name: Master Condottiero
entries: {@i Rank Four | 5000 PEX}

You stand as one of the most famous mercenaries in the world. You change the tides of fate and your name belongs among the greatest soldiers ever lived. You may even have a mercenary army of your own that stands as one of the proudest in the realm.
You can purchase the following abilities with PEX:

entries.name: Expending Network
entries: You try to meet with potential contractors, ones that could afford your services, and in the process meet new people: potential recruits for your mercenary group, a black market dealer, a merchant or a blacksmith for your adventures. You make a Charisma check and spend 25 gd to see how well you succeeded in getting in touch with necessary people.

entries.caption: Expending Network
rows: One contact.
Two contacts.
Two contacts.
Three contacts.
A single, very important individual.

entries: The personality, CR, statblocks and all other aspects of the contact depends...

entries.name: Mercenary Band
entries: You can initiate important steps to creating a group of mercenaries under your command. If you have a powerful band, more customers may try to strike a contract with you. Work with your GM for the expenses and possible base of operations for such endeavors. You can check out the Forge Your Own Holy Order entries in one of our previous titles, Era of the Crusades, as it contains guidelines and suggestions for building a guild or band of your own.
You roll a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) and Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check at the end of your downtime and determine the results with the table below:

entries.caption: Charisma (Persuasion)
rows: You find 1d4 people who are potentially willing to join.
You find 2d4 people who are potentially willing to join.
You find 2d4 + 5 people who are potentially willing to join.
You find a long list of people waiting on your doorstep to be enlisted by you.

entries.caption: Wisdom (Insight)
rows: You notice if there are any unskilled or unsuited ones among the group.

The result above plus you notice potential unwanted qualities among the group (a tendency for thievery, tendency for slacking off, tendency for unnecessary violence or similar properties of the candidates. Work with your GM for the qualities in the candidates that you'd like).
The results above plus you notice any ill-intent toward you, potential enemies and spies among the crowd.
You read each of them like an open book, excluding important NPCs with considerably higher Challenge Ratings, which the GM may require additional checks to determine their motives and state of mind.

optionalfeature.name: Cheap Shot
entries: As an opponent moves into your melee range, you can use a reaction to use an unarmed strike against them to throw their attack off balance. On a hit, you deal damage as normal and impose disadvantage on their next attack roll until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Exquisite Punch
entries: If you move at least 10 feet before attacking, you can perform a flying punch. Make an unarmed strike as one of your attacks, but your unarmed strike deals {@damage 1d8} bludgeoning damage rather than 1. If you roll a 16 or higher on the d20, the enemy is {@condition stunned} until it takes damage or until the start of its next turn. You must hit the creature for this effect to work.

optionalfeature.name: Skewer
entries: If you move at least 10 feet before attacking, you can perform a diving tackle on a target no larger than one size above yours. On a hit, you deal {@damage 1d6} force damage. If you roll a 15 or higher on the d20, the enemy falls {@condition prone}. You must hit the creature for this effect to work.

optionalfeature.name: Flying Kick
entries: If you move at least 10 ft. before attacking, you can perform a diving two-footed kick. On a hit, you deal {@damage 1d8} bludgeoning damage and can push the target up to 10 ft. away if you roll a 15 or higher on the d20. You must hit the creature for this effect to work.

optionalfeature.name: Rhythm of the Crowd
entries: You can activate this ability when you enter a Revel. Until the end of your Revel, moving through crowds of people does not count as difficult terrain for you, and you can take the {@action Dash} action as a bonus action.

optionalfeature.name: Blend In
entries: You can expend a use of your Signature Moves and gain a +10 bonus to your {@skill Stealth} checks. If you attack while in Stealth and gain advantage on the attack roll due to being hidden from your enemy, you can reroll one of the d20s. You can do this once per day.

optionalfeature.name: Unerring Senses
entries: {@i 50 PEX}: Listening to the crowds is the key to this job.
By eavesdropping on conversations on the streets and dark alleys, your hearing and sight has improved greatly. You gain proficiency in the Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) skill.

optionalfeature.name: Crowded Escape
entries: {@i 50 PEX}: Blending in is an art after all.

Hiding among the crowds has become second nature to you. Whenever you take the {@action Hide} action in crowded places, you can double your proficiency bonus when rolling your Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) check. On a success, you are not only counted as being under the {@condition invisible} condition for as long as you remain out of sight of your pursuers, but you can also {@action Dash} as a bonus action to make a getaway. You cannot use the Dash to knowingly move closer to an enemy.

optionalfeature.name: Lies! Deception!
entries: {@i 50 PEX}: "I solemnly swear that I am up to no good."

You have become quite adept at presenting yourself to other eyes in a deceitful manner. When an ability check is made against your {@skill Deception} or {@skill Performance} to reveal the truth, it is made with disadvantage.

optionalfeature.name: Urban Sense
entries: {@i 50 PEX}: "I am a hundred percent sure I have seen this alley before."
Your inner compass in urban areas is nearly unmatched by others. You have advantage on any ability check to find your way in an urban area.

optionalfeature.name: Mendicant Specialization
entries: {@i 100 PEX}

You choose a specialization in your profession. You will either be a Spider or an Owl. Spiders focus on establishing a network through the streets and collecting rumors and secrets, while Owls focus on stealth and secrecy.

optionalfeature.name: Web of the Spider
entries: You can spend your PEX and coins in order to establish a strong web of connections. Work with your GM to create necessary NPCs from the table below (Your Network) or choose the right ones in the Bestiary entries. The names given in bold appear in the Bestiary; however, GMs can come up with their own preference of statblocks depending on the setting and the rules of their table.

entries.caption: Your Network
rows: Finance Elite ({@creature street actor|EchoesOfRenaissance}, {@creature street acrobat|EchoesOfRenaissance}, {@creature street dancer|EchoesOfRenaissance}, or similar stat blocks)
On a weekly or a monthly basis, GM has them roll a Charisma check (appropriate skill proficiencies may apply) and determine how much coin they bring.
10 PEX
8 gd/month
Field Agent ({@creature Guard}, {@creature vendor|EchoesOfRenaissance}, {@creature merchant of Venice|EchoesOfRenaissance}, {@creature thug}, or many others)
On a weekly or a monthly basis, GM has them roll a Wisdom/Intelligence or a related ability check to determine if they bring valuable information (appropriate skill proficiencies may apply).
10 PEX
10 gd/month

Operator ({@creature condottieri|EchoesOfRenaissance}, {@creature seafarer|EchoesOfRenaissance}, {@creature gondolier|EchoesOfRenaissance}, {@creature temperatore|EchoesOfRenaissance}, or many others)
You can send these Operators for specific operations, such as a heist, an intimidation task, or gathering information. An operator can be used once per week or month, at the discretion of the GM.
25 PEX
15 gd/month

optionalfeature.name: Sight of the Owl
entries: You can spend your PEX and coins in order to gain abilities mentioned in the table below (Owl in the Night). With them you are able to roam the streets and get the job done yourself.

entries.caption: Owl in the Night
rows: Picking Locks
You gain proficiency with {@item thieves' tools}.
25 PEX
15 gd
Better Vision
Dim light does not impose disadvantage on your sight and related rolls.
25 PEX
Silent Steps
When you successfully use the {@action Hide} action, you impose disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks to notice you.
30 PEX
Trap Master
You take half damage from traps if the damage is nonmagical.
50 PEX
Combat Training
You gain proficiency with a weapon of your choice and a piece of light armor of your choice. The armor can instead be shields.
50 PEX
25 gd
Agility Training
You gain proficiency in {@skill Stealth} and {@skill Sleight of Hand} skills.
50 PEX
25 gd
Close Inspection
You gain proficiency in {@skill Investigation} and {@skill Insight} skills.
50 PEX
25 gd

optionalfeature.name: Disguise Adept
entries: {@i 100 PEX}: "It is probably a good idea if a city guard does not see the same face twice in a row."
You gain proficiency with the {@item disguise kit}, and you can acquire it for half of the normal cost.

optionalfeature.name: Appraise
entries: {@i 100 PEX}: "The metal does not taste right."
You immediately understand if a coin is fake or not.

optionalfeature.name: Careful by Nature
entries: {@i 100 PEX}: Nothing gets past your attention.
Your passive Perception score increases by 3.

optionalfeature.name: Honed Senses
entries: {@i 100 PEX}: "Focus on the words and reading the mouths."
You can read lips and understand what the people are saying if you know the language. In addition, being in a loud crowd does not impose disadvantage on your Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks.

optionalfeature.name: Harsh Conditions
entries: {@i 100 PEX}: You are used to sleeping under the stars, no?
You have advantage on saving throws against extreme weather conditions due to your being accustomed to surviving on the streets.

optionalfeature.name: Mendicant Specialization Improvement
entries: {@i 200 PEX}
You know the streets better than almost anyone, and your specialized abilities have become incredibly strong.

entries.name: Great Spider
entries: You are immune to the {@condition charmed} condition and automatically understand if anyone is charmed by magical means. If an enchantment spell is directed at you, you are immune to its effects.

entries.name: Night Owl
entries: You have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks and are able to see even when there's little light. You gain darkvision to a range of 30 ft. If you already have one, its range increases by 30 ft.

optionalfeature.name: Expert Sneak
entries: {@i 200 PEX}: "Sneaking around is the definition of this job."
You have advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.

optionalfeature.name: Resistant
entries: {@i 200 PEX}: "You must have seen a few brawls here and there."
Your time in the streets has hardened you through a crucible of pain. You gain resistance to a damage type of your choice: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, or poison.

optionalfeature.name: Face of Innocence
entries: {@i 200 PEX}: "The most sincere smile on the face."
If your total for a Charisma ({@skill Deception} or {@skill Performance}) check is less than your Charisma score, you can use that score in place of the total.

optionalfeature.name: Stories of the Past
entries: {@i Free}: "Oh, have I told you about the time when..."

You have a lot of experiences and stories, and have probably taken part in some of the legends and myths. You have the ability to inspire greatness in others. You can grant Inspiration to anyone who listens to your stories a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus daily. This Inspiration point must be used in 1 hour, or it will be lost. Anyone who already has Inspiration won't be affected by this. As an alternative, the creatures who listen can roll on their Legendary Inspiration table or draw or draw a card from the Deck of the Legendary Inspirations.

optionalfeature.name: Vox Viarum, Voice of the Streets
entries: {@i Free}: "Nothing escapes my ears and eyes."

While you are in a crowd, you automatically succeed on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks to {@action Hide}, and you can only be found by magical means. For the purposes of this ability, mendicating on a busy street or in a bustling square counts as a "crowd" for you, whether you are in the throng or not.

Additionally, once per week you can learn a very important secret. Work with your GM on what the secrets may be, but they have the final say on the level of information (though it should be considerably more important than the information gathered by your operator network, if you are a Spider). Examples of secrets you could learn are the location of a secret stash of treasure, the entrance to a highly secretive guild, the exact location of a magic item within a fortified keep, the upcoming daily itinerary of a hated foe, and so forth.

optionalfeature.name: Mounted Warrior
entries: {@i 50 PEX}: "You enjoyed that carrot, didn't you?"

A mount is crucial for transportation for an esteemed warrior such as yourself. You can spend an hour with a horse or a similar mount at your discretion. When the mount finishes a long rest, it gains temporary hit points equal to your character level, and its Armor Class increases equal to your proficiency bonus while you mount it.

optionalfeature.name: Resting in Armor
entries: {@i 50 PEX}: "Will you sleep in that chunk of metal?"

You can fully rest while wearing any kind of armor with full benefits, and if combat begins while you are sleeping, you can use your reaction to get up or don a {@item shield} if it is within 5 ft. of you.

optionalfeature.name: Long Strides
entries: {@i 50 PEX}: "It looks like I am going on an adventure."
You need half of the food and water that people normally need to survive, and when you finish a long rest, you reduce your {@condition exhaustion} levels by 2.

optionalfeature.name: Terrain Advantage
entries: {@i 50 PEX}: "Knowing your surroundings is a surefire way to victory."

If you spend at least a minute analyzing your surroundings, natural difficult terrain does not reduce your movement speed, and you have advantage on ability checks related to the terrain (for example, climbing a tree rapidly).

optionalfeature.name: Adept Training
entries: {@i 50 PEX}: "Practice is golden."
You spend your time honing your skills. You gain proficiency with two weapons or one piece of armor of your choice.

optionalfeature.name: Honed Muscles
entries: {@i 50 PEX}: "You don't work for nothing, right?"
Your time in harsh conditions has improved your muscles. You gain proficiency in the {@skill Athletics} skill. In addition, your carrying capacity is doubled.

optionalfeature.name: Sturdy Legs
entries: {@i 50 PEX}: "Footwork is how you win in a fight."
Your movement speed increases by 5 ft.

optionalfeature.name: Condottiero Specialization
entries: {@i 100 PEX}
You choose a specialization option. You either choose the Honor path to prove your courage on the battlefield, or the Captain path to inspire your allies.

optionalfeature.name: Honor
entries: When you roll for Initiative, you have 1d4 temporary hit points if you have a proficiency bonus of +2. While you have those temporary hit points, you can't be {@condition frightened}. Each time your proficiency bonus increases, the temporary hit points increase by 5. For example, an 11th level character has 1d4 + 10 temporary hit points. Other temporary hit point sources do not replace this effect. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus and can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Captain
entries: When you roll for Initiative, you can use your reaction to choose two allies that can hear you. They add your proficiency bonus to their Initiative rolls. Instead, you can force two enemy creatures to succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or subtract your proficiency bonus from their Initiative rolls. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus and can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Sturdy
entries: {@i 100 PEX}: "You are a resilient one, aren't you?"
When you finish a short rest, you restore additional hit points equal to your character level.

optionalfeature.name: Fighting Training
entries: {@i 100 PEX}: "I can do this all day."
You choose a {@filter Fighting Style|optionalfeatures|feature type=fs:f} from the Fighter class. It must be different from the ones you may have.

optionalfeature.name: Armor Adept
entries: {@i 100 PEX}: "It is not just armor; it is about the warrior who wears it."
While wearing armor, you take 2 less damage. This damage reduction increases when you reach certain character levels: 4th (3), 8th (4), 12th (5), 17th (6).

optionalfeature.name: Counting the Numbers
entries: {@i 100 PEX}: "How many did you count?"
When you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check about an enemy group that you can see, you know their numbers. If it is beyond thousands you have an approximate number.

optionalfeature.name: Condottiero Specialization Improvement
entries: {@i 200 PEX}
Your way of expertise in your profession has improved over time. Your chosen specialization gets additional benefits as stated below:

entries.name: Chivalrous
entries: You learn the {@spell herculean might|EchoesOfRenaissance} cantrip and can cast it at will and learn {@spell Li Jin's impervious charge|EchoesOfRenaissance} twice a day without expending a spell slot. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spell.

entries.name: Captain
entries: You learn the cantrip {@spell Li Jin's tactical movement|EchoesOfRenaissance} and can cast it at will and learn {@spell Li Jin's agile mobility|EchoesOfRenaissance} twice a day without expending a spell slot. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spell.

optionalfeature.name: Proficient One
entries: {@i 200 PEX}: "Training was key, remember?"
You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.

optionalfeature.name: Superior Movement
entries: {@i 200 PEX}: "The upper hand in combat is through speed."
You can use your bonus action to gain a walking speed equal to half of your remaining speed.

optionalfeature.name: Analyze the Foe
entries: {@i 200 PEX}: "Know thy enemy."

You can use an action to make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight} or {@skill Perception}) or Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to analyze a creature you can see within 120 ft against the target's Charisma ({@skill Deception} or {@skill Performance}) check. On a success, you know any resistances, vulnerabilities, and immunities the creature has.

optionalfeature.name: Master Eyes
entries: {@i 200 PEX}: "Who are you, I wonder."

If you succeed on a Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check against a creature or spot a creature through a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check, you can force the creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. The DC is equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier. On a failed save, you know if the creature is a shapechanger or somehow affected by illusion spells.

optionalfeature.name: Strong Mind
entries: {@i 100 PEX}: "Ready yourself mentally for a battle."
You gain proficiency in Wisdom or Intelligence saving throws.

optionalfeature.name: Stories of the Past
entries: {@i Free}: "Oh, have I told you about the time when..."

You have a lot of experiences and stories, and have probably taken part in some of the legends and myths. You have the ability to inspire greatness in others. You can grant Inspiration to anyone who listens to your stories a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus daily. This Inspiration must be used in 1 hour, or it will be lost. Anyone who already has Inspiration won't be affected by this. As an alternative, the creatures who listen can roll on their Legendary Inspiration table or draw a card from the Legendary Inspirations Deck.

optionalfeature.name: Charismatic Leader
entries: {@i Free}: "My soldiers, rage!"

You utter a command as an action to those all can hear you. The creatures gain temporary hit points equal to your character level, and they can't be {@condition frightened} for the next 8 hours. If they are {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}, the condition ends. If they are possessed, they immediately roll a saving throw to be free from the effect. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Pact of the Canvas
entries: Your patron grants you the ability to summon the creatures you draw. You can use a canvas or thin air to activate your ability.

You must spend at least 1 minute for each CR of the creature and consult the table below for the creatures you can conjure. A conjured creature stays for 10 minutes or until its HP drops to 0. For the duration it is friendly towards you and your companions and acts on its own initiative.
As a bonus action, you can change the creature's type between its original type and construct. While a construct it has these features instead of the corresponding parts in its statblock:

items: {@b Damage Resistances:} slashing and piercing damage
{@b Damage Immunities:} psychic, poison, and necrotic
{@b Condition Immunities:} {@condition charmed}, {@condition exhaustion}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition petrified}, {@condition poisoned}

entries.caption: Pact of the Canvas Summons
rows: {@filter Any beast|bestiary|type=beast|miscellaneous=!swarm}, {@filter Celestial|bestiary|type=celestial|miscellaneous=}, {@filter fey or fiend with a maximum CR of 1/2|bestiary|Challenge Rating=[&0;&1/2]|type=fey;fiend}, {@creature Ink-heart Spirit|EchoesOfRenaissance}
{@creature Ink-heart Hellspawn|EchoesOfRenaissance}, {@creature Ink-heart Angel|EchoesOfRenaissance}, {@creature Ink-heart Fairy|EchoesOfRenaissance}, {@creature Ink-heart Animal|EchoesOfRenaissance}
{@creature Ink-heart Guardian|EchoesOfRenaissance}, {@creature Ink-heart Lancer|EchoesOfRenaissance}, {@creature Ink-heart Mystic|EchoesOfRenaissance}
{@creature Ink-heart Bulwark|EchoesOfRenaissance}, {@creature Ink-heart Warrior|EchoesOfRenaissance}
{@creature Ink-heart Knight|EchoesOfRenaissance}
{@creature Ink-heart Magus|EchoesOfRenaissance}

entries: The GM may add creatures to the table for a Pact of the Canvas, such as a {@creature bearded devil}, {@creature pegasus}, or {@creature polar bear}.

You need a special ink made of magical liquids that costs 25 gp per CR and a body-part or essence of the creature. If the creature is an Ink-heart, you do not need a body part. You can summon a creature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus and regain expended uses when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Magical Effects
entries: Choosing the pact of the canvas allows a subtle bit of magic around you to appear. Consult the table below or come up with your own with the discretion of the GM.

entries.caption: Magical Effects
rows: You can turn water into a colorful paint when you touch it. Sometimes this happens by accident.
You usually smell as if bathed in paint instead of water.
You sometimes find random drawings in your pockets that you are sure you didn't draw but look like you did.
Sometimes the pictures or reflections around you move or act weirdly but for very briefly and for one person.
You hear whispers from the canvases of other painters, as if rivals and masters were sharing their wisdom and desires.

You can perceive colors as having distinct sensory qualities besides their hue: emotional, auditory, olfactory, and so forth. These can shift from day to day, might seem random to you, and may not match cultural biases: for instance, one day a particular shade of yellow might smell like flowers and exude happiness, while another day it might bring to one's nostrils the putrescence of plague. Also, purple is often denoted to mean royalty, but for you it might sound like a wailing sea creature.

optionalfeature.name: Pact of the Saddle
entries: You are granted the ability to summon a mount in and out of combat. You have a magical trinket that is tiny and possibly worn by you, such as a ring, necklace, wristband or similar. You learn the {@spell find steed} spell and can cast it without expending a spell slot. For you, the mount you summon, while alive, can be summoned or dismissed with a bonus action and you can directly summon it on the space you occupy and mount it using your reaction, as if the spirit is conjured right under you. You can also dismiss it as a bonus action and immediately dismount it safely using your reaction.
When you reach 6th-level, you can cast the {@spell find greater steed} spell without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Pact of the Tombstone
entries: Your soul is put into an object of your choice: meanwhile, your body becomes pale, is cold to the touch, and you lose your ability to taste things. The object is put into a place of your patron's choice and is protected by a method of the GM's choosing. While protected in this way, if you die, your soul returns to your body, and the {@spell revivify} spell is cast on you instantly. If you are in a condition beyond the spell's effects, such as if you are beheaded, your soul simply belongs to your patron now, but it can be resurrected through other means.

You carry another enchanted object related to the original object that carries your soul—for example, a tiny key to open a locket that carries your soul. This tiny object can be used as a spellcasting focus for your warlock spells.
While holding it, you can cast a necromancy spell without expending a spell slot or one of your Mystic Arcanum uses. You can do so twice per short rest.

optionalfeature.name: Astral Spirit
entries: You no longer need food or water. Your Constitution score and maximum hit points cannot be reduced with spells, features or curses.

optionalfeature.name: Spell Disruptor
entries: You can summon a wyrmling dragon of your choice with your Pact of the Canvas without needing a body part or essence.

optionalfeature.name: Crystal Eyes
entries: You see {@condition invisible} creatures and objects as if they were visible, and you can see into the Ethereal Plane. Ethereal creatures and objects appear ghostly and translucent. You can share this feature with a creature that you touch for 1 minute but you lose it for the duration and can't share it again with another creature until you finish a short or long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Deadly Arcana
entries: You add your Charisma modifier to one of the damage rolls of your necromancy spells that deal damage.

optionalfeature.name: Deadly Whispers
entries: You can cast {@spell animate dead} once without expending a spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Sense
entries: You can cast the {@spell archaic sense|EchoesOfRenaissance} spell at will without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Hellspawn Hound
entries: The mount you summon is under the effects of the {@spell heroism} spell, and whenever it takes damage, you can use your reaction to halve the damage against it.

optionalfeature.name: Mounted Strikes
entries: When you make an attack or cast a harmful spell, the mount can use its reaction to attack a creature within its reach. In addition, it always adds your Charisma modifier to one if its damage rolls per attack.

optionalfeature.name: Strong Canvas
entries: Your summons add your proficiency bonus to their attack rolls, ability check, and saving throws.

optionalfeature.name: Sturdy Canvas
entries: Your summons gain temporary hit points equal to your warlock level when they are summoned and when you expend a warlock spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Sturdy Mount
entries: The mount you summon gains the benefits of the {@spell death ward} spell when you finish a long rest. When {@spell death ward}'s effect takes place, the mount is safely dismissed into a pocket dimension unless you summon it with your bonus action.

optionalfeature.name: Touch of the Grave
entries: You can cast the {@spell inflict wounds} spell three times a day without expending a spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Gladiator

prerequisite.other: Net and Trident proficiency

entries: {@i Your preferred method of fighting harkens back to the sand and blood of the arena, when thousands of supporters chanting your name would echo for eternity...}

entries.name: Net Mastery
entries: Using your {@item net} to tackle and incapacitate your enemies is second nature to you. You can use your net's long range without having disadvantage on your attack roll. While you have a {@item net} in your hand and a {@item trident} in the other, you can use your bonus action to use the net, or make an additional attack.

entries.name: Trident Versatility
entries: You can use your {@item net} not just to immobilize, but to distract and land a free hit in the heat of combat. If you hit a creature with the net, you can use your reaction to make an attack roll with your {@item trident}.

entries.name: Pull back the Net
entries: Once your prey is caught, it becomes a matter of pulling the ground under their feet to destroy any semblance of balance. If your {@item net} is not destroyed, you can retrieve it with your reaction if it's within your reach. If a creature was caught by it, the creature must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check or fall {@condition prone} when you retrieve your net.

optionalfeature.name: Lifestealing Duelist

prerequisite.other: A cantrip that deals necrotic damage, a free hand, and a melee weapon which you are proficient with that can deal slashing or piercing damage

entries: {@i Even if your body withers from a thousand cuts, you continue fighting. For your enemy can give back whatever blood you lost!}

entries.name: Arcane Tether
entries: When you make an attack roll with your weapon, you can infuse your necromancy cantrip's power into attacks you make. On a melee hit, the attack deals the necrotic damage of the cantrip as normal in addition to its regular damage, but it does not apply any other effect it may have. For example, while striking with a dagger, you can imbue the {@spell chill touch} spell's necrotic damage to the dagger. On a hit, you roll damage as normal (1d4 + any relevant modifier) plus 1d8 necrotic damage dealt (rounded up). The damage of this ability scales with the increase in cantrip damage as you level up (1d8 to 2d8, and so on).

entries.name: Blood Residue
entries: If you have used your Arcane Tether effect in the last 8 hours, you may use Blood Residue when you finish a short rest. You regain extra HP equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

entries.name: Necrotic Barrier
entries: When you take necrotic damage, as a reaction you have resistance to the necrotic damage, but you gain vulnerability to the next instance of damage until the end of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Draconic Breath

prerequisite.other: Holding a one-handed melee weapon which you are proficient with

entries: {@i With my very breath, I honor my ancestors.}

entries.name: Elemental Weapon
entries: You can use your bonus action to use your breath weapon and imbue its power in a weapon you hold and are proficient with. You roll your breath weapon's damage dice. For equal rounds, the damage you deal with your imbued weapon deals additional 1d4 damage of the associated ancestral element. For example, a dragonborn with gold dragon ancestry deals additional 1d4 fire damage with the weapon.

entries.name: Overdamage
entries: When you roll a critical hit with your Elemental Weapon, you deal additional damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

entries.name: The Element You Know
entries: When you take damage from your draconic ancestry's damage type, you have advantage on your next attack roll.

optionalfeature.name: Voice of the Commander

prerequisite.other: Proficiency in a Charisma skill; One free hand

entries: {@i You let forth a resolute cry and inspire your allies to reach unforeseen greatness.}

entries.name: Move!
entries: You can use your bonus action to command a creature that can hear you. That creature can use its reaction to move half of its speed or use an action other than attacking or casting a harmful spell.

entries.name: Attack!
entries: You can use your action to command up to three creatures that can hear you. Those creatures can add your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1) to their potential attack rolls or ability checks.

entries.name: Military Rest
entries: While taking a short rest, five allies of your choice regain hit points equal to your Charisma modifier.

optionalfeature.name: A Knight's Might

prerequisite.other: A bladed weapon in one hand and shield in the other

entries: {@i I am the blade of my lord and the shield of my lord's people.}

entries.name: Parry
entries: When you are hit, you can use your reaction to increase your Armor Class equal to your proficiency bonus and potentially to attack to miss you. This Armor Class increase works only for that attack. If you are still hit, you are counted as not using your reaction so you can attempt a Parry again.

entries.name: Shield Bash
entries: When an attack misses you, you can make an attack roll as a reaction with your shield for a quick strike. You are counted as proficient with this attack, and it deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage, or some other damage type depending on the shield you are using. You add modifiers as normal.

entries.name: Shield Wall
entries: An ally with the Shield Wall property grants +2 bonus to your AC when standing within 5 ft. of you.

optionalfeature.name: Halberd Warrior

prerequisite.other: Proficiency with halberds

entries: {@i The key to being an excellent guard is to never let the enemy get near you.}

entries.name: Hooked End
entries: You can use a bonus action to attempt to shove a creature or force them to fall {@condition prone} if you have hit them this round. The DC is equal to 8 + proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier.

entries.name: Disarming Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can force the creature to make a Strength saving throw (DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier) instead of dealing damage. On a failed save, you knock their weapon out of their hand. The weapon flies a distance equal to your Strength modifier (If your STR is 15, the weapon lands 15 ft. away).

entries.name: Charging Strike
entries: If you move 10 ft. before making an attack, you deal an extra 2d6 damage, but you can't make more attacks until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Steppe Mounted Archer

prerequisite.other: A bow proficiency suitable to horse-archery; Being mounted

entries: {@i The thundering of hooves means it is already too late.}

entries.name: The Open Sky
entries: When you hit with an attack roll with your bow which you have advantage on, you can reroll one of the damage dice once and take the higher result.

entries.name: Charging Strike
entries: If you move 10 ft. before making an attack, you deal an extra 2d6 damage, but you can't make more attacks until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: High Impact
entries: When you deal damage with a ranged weapon further than its normal range, you deal an extra 2d6 damage.

optionalfeature.name: Conqueror's Might

prerequisite.other: Holding a flail and shield and being proficient with both of them

entries: {@i Your flail and shield are the grim scales of justice which your foes find themselves balanced on.}

entries.name: Mighty Swing
entries: You swing your flail with high velocity to increase your Armor Class by an amount equal to your proficiency bonus, but you must concentrate on this ability. If your concentration is broken, your Armor Class bonus is lost, and it is further reduced by the same amount. You can willingly end your concentration to deal a Velocity Strike, which replaces one attack. If you end it willingly, you suffer no penalties except the one mentioned in Velocity Strike.

entries.name: Velocity Strike
entries: You add your proficiency bonus to your damage rolls, but you can't benefit from your shield. All effects last until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Shield Bash
entries: When you are hit by an attack within your reach, you can use your reaction to bash the target with your shield. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + Strength modifier) or fall {@condition prone}.

entries.name: Shield Wall
entries: An ally with the Shield Wall property grants +2 bonus to your AC when standing within 5 ft of you.

optionalfeature.name: Double Light Weapon

prerequisite.other: Holding two light weapons you are proficient with in your hands

entries: {@i A shield is unnecessary if you strike and move with the speed of the wind.}

entries.name: Defensive Stance
entries: If you move no more than 5 ft. this turn, you can use your bonus action to ready your weapon and add +2 bonus to your Armor Class against melee weapon attacks.

entries.name: Footwork
entries: If you don't make an attack this turn, your movement speed increases by 5 ft.

entries.name: Quick Strike
entries: When you use your bonus action to use your weapon in your other hand (as stated in Two Weapon Fighting rules), you can make another attack with the same light weapon. However, you don't add your ability score modifier to the damage roll of this second attack.

optionalfeature.name: Two-Handed Polearm

prerequisite.other: Spear, Glaive, Halberd, or Pike proficiency; Holding the weapon with both hands

entries: {@i Stand firm, keep your formation, and strike with the force of a raging storm.}

entries.name: Charging Strike
entries: If you move 10 ft. before making an attack, you deal an extra 2d6 damage, but you can't make more attacks until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Thrust
entries: When you hit an opponent with the weapon you can forgo your next attack until the start of your next turn to deal an extra 1d4 damage. You must decide when you hit the creature. You don't add your ability score modifier to the 1d4.

entries.name: Hold the Line
entries: You can use your reaction to make an attack roll against a creature that enters your reach. You don't add your ability score modifier to the damage.

optionalfeature.name: Grim Warrior

prerequisite.other: Scimitar proficiency and holding two scimitars

entries: {@i These warriors attack with a speed and viciousness that would terrify even the bravest of souls.}

entries.name: Retaliate
entries: When an attack hits or misses you, you can use your reaction to make a weapon attack. On a hit, you don't add your ability score modifier to the damage.

entries.name: Second Reach
entries: When you hit an enemy with an attack, you can use your bonus action to attack a creature within 5 ft. of that enemy with advantage. In doing so, you don't add your ability score modifier to the damage roll.

entries.name: Feint Attack
entries: As a bonus action, you roll for Charisma ({@skill Deception}) against the target's Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check. If it's higher than the target's roll, you roll one of your attacks with advantage. When you do so, you can't make more than one attack until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Poisoner

prerequisite.other: Poisoner's kit proficiency (or a cantrip that deals poison damage) and a one-handed melee weapon that could deal slashing or piercing damage

entries: {@i Relax, you have already ingested your fate. Time is against you.}

entries.name: Weaken the Enemy
entries: When you deal poison damage, you can forgo dealing damage and force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + the ability score modifier you used to deal damage) or become {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns to get rid of the effect.

entries.name: Master Poisoner
entries: If you use your action to strike a creature who is {@condition poisoned}, you can forgo dealing normal damage. The character instead loses maximum hit points. The loss is equal to half of the normal damage you make.

entries.name: Poisonous Sense
entries: When you engage in combat with a creature, you can spend a bonus action to detect if the creature has poison resistance or poison immunity if you roll equal to or higher on an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) or Wisdom ({@skill Insight} or {@skill Perception}) check against the target's Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check.

optionalfeature.name: Shocking Warrior

prerequisite.other: Holding a one-handed melee weapon

entries: {@i I will teach you to regret wearing all that armor.}

entries.name: Coat your Weapon
entries: If you spend a bonus action to imbue your weapon with your cantrip, when you make an Opportunity Attack, you can deal an extra 1d4 lightning damage to the target until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Critical Strike
entries: When you deal a critical hit with your {@spell shocking grasp} cantrip, you deal an additional d8 for the damage total, but you can't cast another cantrip until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Environmental Effects
entries: If creatures you target with your {@spell shocking grasp} cantrip are standing on a watery surface, in actual water, or have been soaked by water (your GM determines the appropriate amount), they receive additional 1d4 lightning damage on a hit.

optionalfeature.name: One Slash

prerequisite.other: Holding a one-handed weapon that deals slashing damage which you are proficient with without the light property, and one free hand

entries: {@i Come, I will show you with a simple cut how foolish your boastful words were.}

entries.name: Agile Stance
entries: You add a +2 bonus to Strength and Dexterity checks during combat rounds against creatures when resolving grapple, prone, disarm and similar checks.

entries.name: Following Attack
entries: If you hit a creature more than once in a turn, your second damage die increases by one size (For example, d8 becomes d10).

entries.name: Bleed Out
entries: If you hit a creature and forgo dealing damage, the creature starts to bleed and it takes 1d4 damage at the start of each of its turns. For each turn, the bleeding damage increases by 1d4. The target can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw to end the effect on itself at the end of each of its turns. Any healing received also ends this condition.

optionalfeature.name: One Hammer

prerequisite.other: Holding a one-handed hammer which you are proficient with and one free hand

entries: {@i I'll stop you in your tracks and smash your teeth in.}

entries.name: Arrest
entries: You can use your bonus action with your free hand to grapple the creature. If you do so, you can't add your ability score modifier to the damage you do to the creature as long as it is grappled by you. The creature you are grappling cannot be one size larger than you.

entries.name: Stunning Offense
entries: When you hit a creature with a one-handed hammer, you can forgo dealing damage and stun the target instead. The target must be no more than one size larger than you. The stun lasts until the start of your next turn. You can use this ability twice a day.

entries.name: Justle
entries: Instead of dealing damage, you can choose to move the creature 5 ft. in any direction. The target must be no more than one size larger than you. If you score a critical hit, this can be 15 ft. instead.

optionalfeature.name: Centurion

prerequisite.other: Holding a shortsword and a tower shield which you are proficient with

entries: {@i You exemplify courage and caution, charging ahead but providing a formidable bulwark.}

entries.name: Protective Stance
entries: The creatures within 5 ft. of you are considered protected by half-cover against ranged attacks coming from an appropriate direction if you spend a bonus action. This feature stays active until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Over the Shield
entries: If you spend a bonus action to put your body behind your shield against one opponent within 5 ft. of you, you have +2 bonus to your Armor Class, but attacks from other directions do not take your tower shield into consideration.

entries.name: Shield Wall
entries: An ally with the Shield Wall property grants +2 bonus to your AC when standing within 5 ft. of you.

optionalfeature.name: Rime Warrior

prerequisite.other: A cantrip that deals cold damage and a one-handed melee weapon which you are proficient with

entries: {@i The winter chill shatters your armor and your will to survive, but I grow ever stronger.}

entries.name: Movement Restriction
entries: When you hit a creature within 5 ft. of you with a weapon attack, you can use your reaction to use your cold damage cantrip as well. The attack made with the cantrip counts as a melee spell attack. On a hit, the cantrip does not deal damage, but it reduces the creature's movement speed to 0 ft.

entries.name: Healing Restriction
entries: When you hit a creature with your cold cantrip, you can forgo dealing damage. If you do so, the creature can't restore hit points and can't receive temporary hit points until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Chill Sense
entries: When you engage in combat with a creature, you can spend a bonus action to detect if the creature has cold resistance or cold immunity if you roll equal to or higher on an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) or Wisdom ({@skill Insight} or {@skill Perception}) check against the target's Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check.

optionalfeature.name: Hawthorn Warrior
entries: {@i With focus and a strong length of hawthorn, I could hold back the tide.}

entries.name: Unbalance
entries: As an action, you can strike a creature's balance point and make it fall {@condition prone}. The target of your strike must be no more than one size larger than you.

entries.name: Tactical Retreat
entries: As a reaction any unsuccessful melee attack against you allows you to move 5 feet away from the attacker without provoking an Opportunity Attack.

entries.name: Hold the Line
entries: You can use your reaction to make an attack roll against a creature that enters your reach. You don't add your ability score modifier to the damage.

entries.name: Hurt
entries: As an action, you can strike a creature's foot and reduce its movement speed by 10 feet for 2 rounds. This effect only works if the creature is a humanoid.

optionalfeature.name: Dirty Fighting

prerequisite.other: Light weapon and a free hand

entries: {@i Forget what the philosophers and kings say – There are no rules in combat.}

entries.name: Raise Dust
entries: As an action, you can throw dust at a creature using your free hand, and that creature is {@condition blinded} for 3 rounds.

entries.name: Pommel Hit
entries: As a bonus action you can Mark one creature within your reach by hitting it with your pommel.

entries.name: Backstep Fighting
entries: As an action, you can move 5 feet away from a creature you are in close combat with, without provoking an Opportunity Attack. After using this action you can use your reaction to make an Opportunity Attack against that creature if the creature is Marked.

entries.name: Feint Attack
entries: As a bonus action, you roll for Charisma ({@skill Deception}) against the target's Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check. If it's higher than the target's roll, you roll one of your attacks with advantage. When you do so, you can't make more than one attack until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: War Medic

prerequisite.other: Healer's Kit; Holding a one-handed weapon and having one free hand

entries: {@i As the world falls to pieces in war, I will be there to mend your wounds.}

entries.name: Healing Touch
entries: As an action, you can activate the self-healing abilities of one of your allies within reach. They can roll a hit die of their own to regain hit points equal to the total + their Constitution modifier.

entries.name: Hold on
entries: When you stabilize a Creature, you don't roll a Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check; it is considered an automatic success, and the creature has temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier.

entries.name: Water of Life
entries: If you heal a creature, the creature gains temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

entries.name: Cauterize
entries: As an action, you can touch a creature and end one of the following conditions on them: {@condition stunned}, {@condition paralyzed} or {@condition frightened}. The creature you've touched takes (1d4) 2 fire damage.

optionalfeature.name: Lone Katana

prerequisite.other: Proficiency in Dexterity Saving Throws; Holding the weapon with two hands

entries: {@i Tranquil as a still pond, swift as a viper.}

entries.name: Tense Peace
entries: As an action, you concentrate on your next move for 1 minute. As long as you maintain concentration, you have +1 bonus to both your AC and attack rolls, but your speed is halved.

entries.name: Quick Draw
entries: You have advantage when rolling for initiative.

entries.name: Unseen Cut
entries: If your first attack against a creature is a critical success, deal an additional 1d12 slashing damage.

entries.name: Sheathed Defense
entries: In combat, roll a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw against the first attack made towards you; on a successful save you have a +2 bonus to AC including the first attack and the remaining ones until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Northerner's Might
entries: {@i The great halls of Valhalla will sing of my victories tonight.}

entries.name: Strike from Above
entries: Every time you attack from above, get an additional +2 on both your attack roll and damage roll.

entries.name: Dazing Strike
entries: When you roll 12 on your damage die, the creature you hit makes their next attack with disadvantage.

entries.name: Unstoppable Momentum
entries: When you kill an enemy with your attack, you may attack once more against an enemy within your reach.

entries.name: Battlecry
entries: As an action, you shout a battle cry. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and become {@condition frightened} for the duration (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier).

optionalfeature.name: Whip & Sword
entries: {@i You delight in controlling your opponents with the lash before striking deep with your blade.}

entries.name: Arrest
entries: You can use your bonus action with your whip to grapple a creature within 10 feet. If you do so, you can't add your ability score modifier to the damage you do to the creature as long as it is grappled by you. The creature you are grappling cannot be one size larger than you.

entries.name: Bonus Lash
entries: If you miss with your first whip attack in a turn, you can attack once more with your sword in the same turn using your bonus action.

entries.name: Disarming Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack roll using your whip, you can force the creature to make a Strength saving throw (DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier) instead of dealing damage. On a failed save, you can knock their weapon out of their hand. The weapon flies a distance equal to your Strength modifier (If your STR is 15, the weapon lands 15 ft. away).

optionalfeature.name: Katana and Wakizashi

prerequisite.other: Proficiency in Dexterity Saving Throws

entries: {@i Patience and wisdom count as much as power.}

entries.name: Second Blade
entries: If you haven't attacked any creature on your turn, you can use your bonus action to attack with your wakizashi. This attack deals 1d6 piercing damage, and then half that amount as slashing damage at the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Stationary Defense
entries: As an action, you can focus on defending yourself. gain a +2 bonus to your AC, but you cannot take the Attack action or move in the same turn. This effect lasts for 1 round and cannot be stacked.

entries.name: Revanche
entries: If a melee attack misses you while you are in Stationary Defense, you can use your reaction to attack with your wakizashi.

optionalfeature.name: Hoplite - Shield and Spear

prerequisite.other: Holding a spear in one hand and a shield in the other; you must be proficient with both of them

entries: {@i The echoes of your name cause your enemies to tremble as your shield inspires your comrades in the battlefield.}

entries.name: Urchin
entries: As an action, raise your shield to a defensive position. You gain +2 bonus to your AC, but your speed is halved, and your damage die for the spear is considered 1d4 as long as you remain in this stance.

entries.name: Hold the Line
entries: While you are in the Urchin stance, you can use your reaction to make an attack roll to a creature that enters your reach. You don't add your ability score modifier to the damage.

entries.name: Blunt Arch
entries: As an action, you make a sweeping strike with the blunt side of your spear. This strike deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage to all targets in a 5 foot radius.

entries.name: Shield Wall
entries: An ally with the Shield Wall property grants +2 bonus to your AC when standing within 5 ft. of you.

optionalfeature.name: Viking Berserker Double Handaxe

prerequisite.other: Holding two handaxes which you are proficient with

entries: {@i Your place amongst the greatest warriors awaits your presence. Your name will ring in the ears of your enemies.}

entries.name: Better Odds
entries: If you have an enemy within your reach, you don't have disadvantage while throwing a weapon in your hand.

entries.name: Agile Aim
entries: You can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier for throwable weapons even if it's not finesse.

entries.name: Axe Frenzy
entries: If you attack while wielding both your handaxes, you can use your bonus action to attack twice with your other handaxe that you're holding.

entries.name: Battlecry
entries: As an action, you shout a battle cry. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and become {@condition frightened} for the duration (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier).

optionalfeature.name: Light Sword and a Hand Crossbow
entries: {@i Your agile fighting style offers great advantages on the battlefield, matched by very few.}

entries.name: Loaded
entries: As a bonus action, you can load your hand crossbow.

entries.name: Better Odds
entries: If you have an enemy within your reach, you don't have disadvantage while making a ranged attack with your hand crossbow.

entries.name: Pinned
entries: You can use your whole action to pin an enemy with your crossbow. If you hit the creature and it is within 5 ft. of you, you can use your reaction to hit the creature with your light sword. On a hit, you don't add your ability score modifier to the damage. If the creature is not within your reach, its movement speed is reduced by half until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Reaper

prerequisite.other: Proficiency with Herbalism kits and scythe while holding no other weapon or shields

entries: {@i The earth has grown many twisted and sick things, and I am here to do the culling.}

entries.name: Reap
entries: As an action, you make a curved strike with your scythe. Any creature in a 15 foot cone must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 1d10 slashing damage or half as much damage on a successful one. You can't use this feature again until you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Picking
entries: You hold your scythe with your second hand behind the blade, attacking as if it is a thrusting dagger with a reach of 10 ft. This attack deals 1d6 piercing damage on a successful attack roll.

entries.name: Hooked
entries: While wielding your scythe with both hands, as an action, you can pull a creature 5 feet closer to you. The creature must be within 10 feet of you and not larger than your size.

optionalfeature.name: Viking Huskarl Shield and Axe

prerequisite.other: Holding a shield and axe and being proficient with both of them

entries: {@i The spirits of your ancestors praise your sturdiness in battle and bless your arms, facilitating the doom you bring down on your enemies.}

entries.name: Thump
entries: As a bonus action, you can bash your enemies with your shield. On a hit, the creature takes 1d4 bludgeoning damage and is pushed up to 5 feet away from you. Creature cannot be larger than your size.

entries.name: Break Defense
entries: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, by halving your damage, you can decrease its Armor Class equal to your proficiency bonus until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Shield Step
entries: As a bonus action, you hold your shield as a horizontal plane. Any ally using your shield as a step to make a jump strike with their melee weapon gains +2 bonus to their attack roll.

entries.name: Shield Wall
