entries: An ally with the Shield Wall property grants +2 bonus to your AC when standing within 5 ft. of you.

optionalfeature.name: Longbowman
entries: {@i Your instincts and breath control are matched by no other. You allow your inner eye and your senses to work together. That creates wonders.}

entries.name: Focus
entries: As an action, you concentrate on your aim. Unless you move or your concentration is broken, you have advantage on your ranged attacks up to 30 feet for 1 minute.

entries.name: Trip Up
entries: As an action, you can use your bow to make a melee attack against a creature no larger than your size. On a hit, the creature falls {@condition prone}. You use Improvised Weapon rules for damage.

entries.name: Tauten
entries: As an action, tune your bow. Your next successful attack with your bow has +4 bonus to its damage roll when shooting within a 30 foot range.

optionalfeature.name: Pike and Shot

prerequisite.other: Holding a pike in one hand and arquebus in the other; you must be proficient with both of the weapons

entries: {@i You could pierce the skies if you could reach them, for now you make do with the enemies on the battlefield.}

entries.name: Halt
entries: As a defensive maneuver, you lower your arquebus and raise your pike. If you did not move during your last turn, you can use your reaction to force any creature moving inside your reach to make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 1d10 piercing damage. You must use your reaction for this ability to work.

entries.name: Focus
entries: As an action, you concentrate on your aim. Unless you move or your concentration is broken, you have advantage on your ranged attacks up to 30 feet for 1 minute.

entries.name: Improvised Stab
entries: While in the Designated Shot stance, as a reaction you can stab a creature that stepped within 5 feet of you, dealing 1d4 piercing damage.

optionalfeature.name: Vanguard (Greatsword Master)

prerequisite.other: A Greatsword wielded with both hands

entries: {@i Do not be fooled by its cumbersome size: in the hands of a skilled warrior, the greatsword is as fast and accurate a weapon as a dagger, with ten times the range.}

entries.name: Mordhau
entries: By turning your sword upside down in your hand, you can hit your opponents with the hand guard. With this attack, your sword deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage and stuns the creature for 1 minute. At the start of each of their turns, the creature makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw, and on a success the stun ends early. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your Strength modifier. You regain your uses after you finish a long rest. The creature you target with this ability must be no more than one size larger than you.

entries.name: Half Swording
entries: Placing your hand in the middle of the sword, you gain a better grip to strike at openings at the enemy's armor. Use your bonus action to switch to a Half-Swording stance, which remains in effect until you switch back to your regular stance with a free action, or if your concentration is broken. When you are in the Half-Swording stance, you get +2 bonus to your damage rolls and deal piercing damage.

entries.name: Whirlwind
entries: As an action you can swing your sword, forming circles around yourself to deny ground to your enemy. Any creature in your 5 feet radius, or any creature that moves into your 5 feet radius until the start of your next turn, must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save the creature takes 1d8 slashing damage or half as much damage on a successful one. You can't use this feature again until you finish a short rest.

optionalfeature.name: Dwarven Warrior

prerequisite.other: Holding a battleaxe or a greataxe

entries: {@i You were made strong to endure. You are hard as stone and twice as stubborn. You are fast in friendship and enmity alike, and woe to those who are your enemy.}

entries.name: Sprint
entries: When you take the {@action Dash} action, your movement speed increases by an additional 10 ft.

entries.name: Hitting the Nerve System
entries: When you make a critical hit, you can choose to set your movement speed to 0 until the end of your next turn and deal an additional damage equal to your proficiency bonus plus your Strength modifier to the damage total.

entries.name: Incredible Jump
entries: If you spend your action to ready your muscles for jumping, the next time you make a running jump, the distance you cover is doubled.

optionalfeature.name: Janissary Gunner

prerequisite.other: Holding a one-handed firearm and a one-handed weapon which you are proficient with

entries: {@i Firearms are already terrifying; now imagine an expert behind the trigger.}

entries.name: Point Blank
entries: When you attack within 5 ft. with the firearm, the creature must succeed on a DC 11 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they are {@condition blinded} or {@condition deafened} (your choice) until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: At Unfavored Odds
entries: If you have disadvantage on the attack roll and hit the creature, you can reroll your damage die and take the higher result while determining damage.

entries.name: Ottoman Slap
entries: You can choose to make an unarmed strike instead of a normal attack. If you do so, your attack deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage plus your Strength modifier.

optionalfeature.name: Dire Blade

prerequisite.other: A damaging cantrip and a one-handed blade that you are proficient with

entries: {@i If you can do this to yourself, then what can you do to your enemies? It is horrifying even to just imagine it.}

entries.name: Self-Hex
entries: You can use your bonus action to deal yourself damage with your cantrip. Your next attack with your one-handed blade adds that damage plus your spellcasting ability modifier to the damage roll. If you already add your ability score modifier to the damage roll, you add +2 to your weapon's damage while using this feature.

entries.name: At Unfavored Odds
entries: If you have disadvantage on the attack roll with your cantrip and hit, you can reroll your damage die and take the higher result while determining damage.

optionalfeature.name: Maul Warrior

prerequisite.other: Holding a maul which you are proficient with

entries: {@i Your expertise is not just swinging a big bad maul like an uncivilized person; you add a certain panache to it.}

entries.name: Jostle
entries: Instead of dealing damage, you can choose to move the creature 5 ft. in any direction. If you score a critical hit, this can be 15 ft. instead.

entries.name: Mauler
entries: If you score a critical hit with your maul, you may forgo dealing extra damage in order to stun the target. You still deal normal damage if you do so, and the stun lasts until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Sweep
entries: You can spend your action to make a sweeping attack against all enemies within reach with your maul. You roll one attack roll. The enemies you hit take damage equal to your Strength modifier instead of normal damage. If you are a Level 11 or higher character, the damage is equal to your Strength score.

optionalfeature.name: Chain Master

prerequisite.other: Holding a chain in one hand and a one-handed weapon that you are proficient with in the other

entries: {@i Your prowess in battle is proven with your unusual fighting style. You wield chains to remind your enemies that you control their fate.}

entries.name: Chain's Reach
entries: A chain has -5 ft. reach compared to its original size. A 10-foot chain has a reach equal to 5 ft. Maximum reach can be 20 ft. but leaving a chain's reach does not trigger an Opportunity Attack. Chains deal 1d4 bludgeoning damage and require proficiency with simple weapons.

entries.name: Binding
entries: You can use your bonus action to bind a creature within your chain's reach and the creature must be no more than one size larger than you. You make an attack roll with your chain. On a hit, the creature is {@condition grappled}. On subsequent turns, you must spend your bonus action to maintain the grapple or the chain becomes loose. You must spend a bonus action to ready the chain to strike again. If you score a critical hit, the creature is {@condition restrained}. The creature can make a contested Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check against yours at the end of its turns to break free from the effect.

entries.name: Disarming Chain
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack roll with your chain, you can force the creature to make a Strength saving throw (DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier). On a failed save, instead of dealing damage you can shove the weapon from their hand away. The distance is equal to your Strength modifier (If your STR is 15, the weapon lands 15 ft. away).

optionalfeature.name: Silencer

prerequisite.other: A free hand and a weapon in the other hand which you are proficient with

entries: {@i You have always hated how villains gave speeches on how to end your days and conquer the world; you always preferred a nice and quiet battlefield where everyone did their jobs in peace.}

entries.name: Hold Tongue
entries: Instead of dealing damage, you can use your free hand to hinder the creature's speech. On subsequent turns, you can spend one of your attacks to keep silencing the enemy. The creature can't speak while silenced this way; thus, they can't cast spells with verbal components. On their turn, the creature can make a contested Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check; if they succeed, they are free from the effect.

entries.name: Silence!
entries: When you score a critical hit, instead of dealing extra damage, you may damage the creature's tongue or strike its throat. The creature can't speak until the end of your next turn. If it doesn't receive healing or succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw at the end of each ten minute duration it stays this way, the silenced condition continues. The creature can't speak until it finishes a short or long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Esteemed Burglar

prerequisite.other: Holding a one-handed light weapon which you are proficient with

entries: {@i It's not like you are going on an adventure to steal magical jewelry from a dragon or bear said jewelry to a volcano, right? But if you do, it is better to have these skills.}

entries.name: Quick Escape
entries: If you don't attack during a turn (including harmful spells with area of effects), opportunity attacks have disadvantage against you.

entries.name: Unseen
entries: If you are {@condition invisible} or succeed at a {@action Hide} attempt, all checks made to find you have disadvantage.

entries.name: Quick Hands
entries: When you hit a creature with the light weapon you hold, you can use your bonus action to make a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check against their passive Perception scores. On a higher roll, you can steal an item from them that is not being worn.

optionalfeature.name: Illusionist Blade Master

prerequisite.other: Ability to create illusions or the minor illusion cantrip; Holding a one-handed light weapon which you are proficient with, while holding nothing in your other hand

entries: {@i You are adept at combining your illusion spells with the prowess of your arms, better than most spellcasters. Who knows which weapon you hold is real, and which one will actually cut them.}

entries.name: Deceitful Attack
entries: If you spend an action to create an illusion of a weapon in your free hand, you can make a feint attack roll with it. On a hit, you deal no damage but you can attack with the actual light weapon you are holding with advantage as a bonus action.

entries.name: Illusory Protection
entries: You can use your reaction to prevent an attack within your illusion spell's range. You impose disadvantage on the attacker, but you can't cast spells until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Defensive Stance
entries: If you move no more than 5 ft. this turn, you can use your bonus action to ready your weapon and add a +2 bonus to your Armor Class against melee weapon attacks.

optionalfeature.name: Throw Master

prerequisite.other: Carrying weapons with the Thrown property which you are proficient with and at least one free hand

entries: {@i Sometimes your enemies do not expect sharp objects other than the arrows to be flying around a battlefield.}

entries.name: Agile Strike
entries: If you attack with a throwable weapon by throwing it, you can move 5 ft. toward the direction you threw it without triggering an Opportunity Attack.

entries.name: At Unfavored Odds
entries: If you have disadvantage on the attack roll with your throwable weapon and you hit, you can reroll your damage die and take the higher result while determining damage.

entries.name: Agile Aim
entries: You can use your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier for throwable weapons even if it's not finesse.

entries.name: Stuck Weapon
entries: If you hit a creature with a thrown weapon attack, your weapon is stuck in the enemy until the end of your next turn. If you use one of your attacks to press the stuck weapon in, you automatically deal damage. The damage is equal to the weapon's damage die, but you do not add any ability score modifier to the damage roll. After dealing damage in this way, you retrieve the thrown weapon back into your hand.

optionalfeature.name: Cutter

prerequisite.other: Holding two piercing weapons which you are proficient with

entries: {@i Your blades are sharper than most, and your enemies bleed more often than not. Your agility in the face of battle is matched by very few.}

entries.name: Bleed
entries: If you hit a creature and manage to deal damage with both of your hands (using your action and bonus action, for instance), the creature starts to bleed, and it takes 1d4 damage at the start of each of its turns. At the end of each of its turns, the creature can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw to end the effect on itself. Any healing received also ends this condition.

entries.name: Defensive Stance
entries: If you move no more than 5 ft. this turn, you can use your bonus action to ready your weapon and +2 bonus to your Armor Class against melee weapon attacks.

entries.name: Slower
entries: If you hit a bleeding creature, you can choose to drop their speed to 0 instead of dealing damage.

optionalfeature.name: Grenadier

prerequisite.other: Carrying hand grenades which you are proficient with and having one free hand

entries: {@i Your boom and run philosophy has never worked better.}

entries.name: Efficient Use
entries: You can throw as many hand grenades as you have a number of attacks, provided you have a free hand to throw them.

entries.name: Delayed Blast
entries: If you take a readied action to throw one of your hand grenades, you can throw two of them.

entries.name: Dire Choice
entries: If you throw a hand grenade and include yourself in the attack, you can impose disadvantage on a creature's saving throw triggered by the hand grenade within 5 ft. of you as a reaction.

optionalfeature.name: Vile Words

prerequisite.other: A cantrip that deals psychic damage, the ability to speak, and holding a one-handed weapon which you are proficient with

entries: {@i Words are sharper than swords they say, and you are here to prove it.}

entries.name: Sharp Words
entries: You can use your reaction to make a spell attack while a creature attacks an ally within your cantrip's range. The creature takes 1d4 psychic damage on a success, but you can't cast spells until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Bitter Words
entries: When you use your weapon to attack a creature, you can also add the damage of your words to your attacks. You use your reaction to cast your cantrip and mix it with your attacks if you are able to speak. If you do so, you must concentrate on your cantrip and add +2 psychic damage to one of your melee attacks made with your one-handed weapon. If your concentration breaks, you are {@condition stunned} until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Sharpest Blade
entries: You can spend an action to address all enemies that can hear you. They all must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or take 2 psychic damage.

optionalfeature.name: Pugilist

prerequisite.other: Two free hands

entries: {@i Who needs a weapon when your fists exist, right?}

entries.name: Brave
entries: When you receive a critical hit, you can use your reaction to turn the attack into a regular hit. If you do so, you can't attack until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Agile Stance
entries: You add a +2 bonus to Strength and Dexterity checks during combat rounds against creatures when resolving grapple, prone, disarm, and similar checks.

entries.name: Footwork
entries: When you take the {@action Dodge} action, you are less affected when you take damage. Whenever you receive a hit while dodging, you subtract damage equal to twice your proficiency bonus from the damage.

entries.name: Quick Entry
entries: If you move at least 10 ft. before an attack, you add +2 to your damage rolls, but until the end of your next turn all opportunity attacks have advantage against you, including any Opportunity Attack you trigger while moving 10 ft. to gain the damage benefit.

optionalfeature.name: War Chanter

prerequisite.other: Holding a musical instrument which you are proficient with

entries: {@i Your voice and the melodies kindled by your breath stir the hearts of your comrades. Their resolve and your soul make wonderful companions in the heat of battle.}

entries.name: Inspirational Tune
entries: If you spend your action to combine the ability of your voice and the notes of your musical instrument, you can inspire three allies within 60 ft. of you. They add +2 bonus to their attack rolls or saving throws until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Distracting Tune
entries: You can spend your action to distract a foe within 30 ft. of you that can hear you. They gain -2 bonus to their attack rolls until the start of your next turn. You can use your musical instrument for an attack that is made with a bonus action afterwards, if there's a target within your reach. You add your Charisma bonus modifier to the damage if you score a hit.

entries.name: Neglect Damage
entries: You can spend your action to inspire your allies. Three allies of your choice subtract a number equal to your Charisma modifier from the next damage they take. Any remaining damage is converted into temporary hit points.

optionalfeature.name: Elven Archer

prerequisite.other: Holding a ranged weapon which you are proficient with

entries: {@i Your ancient calling and the art of listening to the winds give you an edge on the harsh battlefields.}

entries.name: Aiding Strike
entries: Instead of dealing damage on an attack roll with your ranged weapon, you can distract a foe's defenses. Its Armor Class decreases by a number equal to your proficiency bonus or has disadvantage on its next saving throw.

entries.name: Elven Instinct
entries: When you take the {@action Dodge} action, you don't need to see the attacker to impose disadvantage, and you can make an unarmed strike with your bow to a target within 5 ft. of you. On a hit, you don't add your ability score modifier to the damage.

entries.name: Aim Mastery
entries: If you don't move more than 10 ft. in a turn, you can neglect disadvantage imposed on you. If there is no disadvantage imposed on you, you can add +2 to your ranged attacks but you can't add your ability score modifier to the damage roll if you do so.

optionalfeature.name: Brutal Might of the Half-Orc

prerequisite.other: Holding a weapon without the finesse property which you are proficient with

entries: {@i Your blood boils, and the cries of war in your heart are louder than ever. Your weapon draws its power from your heritage and your indomitable self-belief.}

entries.name: Reliable Focus
entries: You enter a state that lets you focus for one minute, working as if you are concentrating on a spell (but it is not a spell). When you hit a creature, instead of rolling for damage, you deal damage equal to your Strength score once per turn. If your concentration is broken due to taking damage, you are {@condition stunned} until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Break Defense
entries: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, by halving your damage, you can decrease its Armor Class equal to your proficiency bonus until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Brutal Leap
entries: When you leap to a target (you must make a Running Jump for this feature to be available), you can force it to make a Strength saving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + Strength modifier). On a failed save, it falls {@condition prone}.

optionalfeature.name: Artisan's Way of War

prerequisite.other: Holding a one-handed weapon which you are proficient with

entries: {@i Your understanding of the world has made you a better warrior, and your edge in battle does not come only from your agility or strength: it comes from your mind.}

entries.name: Cunning Attack
entries: You can choose to make the next attack roll with your weapon by adding your Intelligence modifier to it instead of Strength or Dexterity, but you can't add your ability score modifier to the damage roll.

entries.name: Cunning Defense
entries: If you wear light armor or no armor at all, you can calculate your Armor Class with your Intelligence modifier instead of Dexterity. For example, if you wear leather armor, your Armor Class is equal to 11 + your Intelligence modifier. However, this feature does not stack with Unarmed Defense, the {@spell mage armor} spell or similar situations. If you calculate your Armor Class in this way, you receive a -2 penalty to your Dexterity saving throws.

optionalfeature.name: Hellish Warrior

prerequisite.other: Holding a one-handed weapon which you are proficient with

entries: {@i A calling from the deep and the traces of hell in your blood strengthen your resolve; your magical abilities are honed in the times of battle.}

entries.name: Thaumaturge
entries: You can use your bonus action to infuse the magical essence of your {@spell thaumaturgy} cantrip into an attack you make until the start of your next turn. On a critical hit, the target becomes {@condition frightened} of you. On a normal hit, you can deal an extra 1d4 psychic damage to the target. You can damage a target like this a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier.

entries.name: Rebuke from the Deep
entries: You can imbue yourself with the power of your inner {@spell hellish rebuke} spell. You can cast it early on yourself using your action without damaging yourself. If you do so, magical flames surround you, and whenever you take a hit in the next minute, the target takes 1d4 fire damage. However, this feature works as if you are concentrating on the spell. Once you use {@spell hellish rebuke} in this way, you can't cast it again until after a long rest.

entries.name: By Fire
entries: When you are hit by fire, you can use your reaction to become immune to the fire damage but can't cast spells until the start of your next turn. You can use this feature twice a day.

entries.name: Darkness Within
entries: You can spend your action to cast your {@spell darkness} spell onto your blade and utilize its power for the next minute. You still concentrate on the spell. During this minute, when you hit with your imbued blade, you force the creature to succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become {@condition blinded} until the start of your next turn (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier).

spell.name: Herculean Might

time.condition: when you or a creature within 30 feet of you fails a Strength or a Constitution check

entries: The magic of myths surrounds a target within range, and it adds {@dice 1d6} to a failed check, possibly turning defeat into a success.

spell.name: Li Jin's Tactical Movement

time.condition: when you or a creature within 30 feet of you fails a Strength or a Constitution check

entries: You invoke the arcane powers first manifested by the great Tang commander from Shaanxi. You choose a creature you can see and that can hear you within range and urge them to move. You grant it the ability to move with their reaction. They can use their reaction to move up to half their speed in that instant.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you reach higher levels, the spell allows you to target more creatures: 5th level (2), 11th level (3), and 17th level (4).

spell.name: Li Jin's Agile Mobility
entries: You choose a creature that you can see and that can hear you within range and invoke the arcane of the great Tang commander Li Jin. It can use its reaction to take one of the actions: {@action Dodge}, {@action Shove}, {@action Use an Object}, or {@action Hide}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can affect one more creature for each slot level above the 1st.

spell.name: Li Jin's Impervious Charge
entries: You invoke the arcane methodologies of the great Tang commander Li Jin to help your allies achieve greater measures of martial prowess. You choose a creature that you can see and that can hear you within range, and it can use its reaction to make an attack roll.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can affect one more creature for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Alter Scent
entries: You magically change the scent of an object within range, such as a sweaty shirt that can smell like lavender or vice versa. A creature can make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check that relies on smell to determine the real scent if it is suspicious at all.
In addition, you can immediately end the spell to detect a specific scent: such as the smell of snow, sulfur, the scent of a rose, or something similar.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you reach certain levels you can target more objects: 2 at 5th level, 3 at 11th level, 4 at 17th level.

spell.name: Barbarossa's Underwater Vitality
entries: You touch a willing creature and grant it the power to breathe underwater until the spell ends. Affected creatures also retain their normal mode of respiration.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: You can target additional creatures when you reach certain levels: 2 at 5th level, 3 at 11th level, 4 at 17th level.

spell.name: Beaux-Arts
entries: You interact with a piece of art within range and make it talk and behave like a human-being related to its nature, as if it came to life. It speaks and behaves according to its nature but can't move more than 5 ft. away from its original space if it has the physical capacity to move (like a statue). For example, if it's a painting, all of the creatures inside it come to life and act accordingly, but the painting itself does not move. If the object is more than 15 ft. away from you, the spell ends early.
You can use an action to make it behave in a way you want to. You must make a DC 10 spellcasting ability check to command it. The piece of art can't attack or harm others.

spell.name: Da Vinci's Mind Lantern

time.condition: which you take when you see a creature within 60 ft. of you fail an Intelligence or Wisdom check

entries: You utter a word of wisdom for guidance and insight. The creature adds {@dice 1d6} to the ability check and possibly turns it into a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you reach certain levels, the bonus increases: 5th level ({@dice 1d8}), 11th level ({@dice 1d10}), and 17th level ({@dice 1d12}).

spell.name: Enchanting Disguise
entries: You touch a mask, bandages, or a similar object used for disguises with a touch of illusion to make it seem more convincing. For the duration, a humanoid wearing the object adds your spellcasting ability modifier to one of the Charisma checks it makes, then the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you reach certain levels, you can enchant more objects with a single cast of this spell: 2 at 5th level, 3 at 11th level, 4 at 17th level.

spell.name: Grave Whispers
entries: You open your soul's eye to the deceased and the veil around you to peek at the other side. For the duration you can do one of the actions and the spell ends early:

entries.name: Last Moments
entries: You touch a creature that died no more than 24 hours ago. You see or hear what it saw or heard last. It is like a momentary movement or sound and not longer than three to six seconds (at the GM's discretion). It can't be used on undead or constructs. You can't use this ability again on the same dead creature. When you reach certain levels, the cantrip gets stronger: At 5th level, the duration is increased to 2 rounds. At 11th level, it is increased to 1 minute, At 17th level, it is increased to 1 hour.

entries.name: Grave Sense
entries: You focus your senses and detect any dead creatures within 30 feet of you. At 5th level, you sense any undead within range. At 11th level, you can cast the cantrip as an action for this feature only. At 17th level, the cantrip duplicates the effects of the {@spell detect evil and good} spell when you use this feature. Additionally, you sense if there is a corpse that was buried without any religious or culturally appropriate ritual or burial within 120 ft.

entries.name: Death's Edge
entries: You touch a stabilized creature with 0 HP. You deal {@damage 1d6} necrotic damage to yourself, and the creature gains 1 HP. The damage and healing increases when you reach certain levels: 5th level ({@damage 2d6} damage, {@dice 1d6} healing), 11th level ({@damage 3d6} damage, {@dice 2d6} healing), 17th level ({@damage 4d6} damage, {@dice 3d6} healing).

entries.name: Gravekeeper
entries: You touch a body that died no more than 3 days ago. If it is buried within the next day, it can't become undead for 10 days. If it remains under the ground it was buried, it can't be raised as an undead from there, either the place must be desecrated or the corpse must be moved elsewhere.

spell.name: Doctor's Sense
entries: You touch a creature and give it {@variantrule Advantage|PHB} on Constitution saving throws. In addition, you have {@variantrule Advantage|PHB} on any Medicine check you make targeting that creature.

When you reach certain levels in this class, this cantrip gets stronger. While you are 5th level, it can duplicate the {@spell detect poison and disease} spell; when you are 11th level, it can duplicate the {@spell prayer of healing} spell once a day; and when you are 17th level, it can duplicate the {@spell remove curse} spell. You can cast each of them once without expending a spell slot and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you reach higher levels, the spell allows you to target more creatures: 5th level (2), 11th level (3), and 17th level (4).

spell.name: Elemental Blade

m.text: a weapon or an ammunition used in the attack worth at least 1 cp

entries: You imbue your weapon with an element of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. With the action you cast this cantrip, you may make a melee attack with the imbued weapon. If the attack hits, it deals an additional {@damage 1d6} damage of the chosen elemental type. You must be proficient with the weapon for this cantrip to work. The spell finishes as soon as you deal damage with it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: This spell's damage increases by {@dice 1d6} when you reach 5th level ({@dice 2d6}), 11th level ({@dice 3d6}), and 17th level ({@dice 4d6}).

spell.name: Inspect Substance
entries: For the duration, you know what the non-living objects you see within 10 feet of you are made of. For example, if there is a sword made of metal within 10 feet of you, you know exactly what metals are used, what kind of tree its wooden hilt is made of, or what kind of leather was used on the grip. You must choose the object when you cast the spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you reach 5th level, you can target up to two objects at once. At 11th level, you can target up to three and at 17th level, you can target up to four.

spell.name: Li Jin's Monstrous Insight
entries: You analyze a creature that you can see within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or you learn one of its resistances or immunities (your choice) and your next attack aimed at the creature deals an additional {@damage 1d4} psychic damage until the start of your next turn. If a creature succeeds on the saving throw, you can't target it again for the next 10 minutes.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you reach 5th level, you can learn two resistances or immunities or can cast the cantrip on two separate creatures. When you reach 11th level the numbers increase to three and when you reach 17th level, the numbers increase to four.
When you reach higher levels, the spell allows you to target more creatures: 5th level (2), 11th level (3), and 17th level (4).

spell.name: Lift Spirits
entries: You utter words of courage, valor, or compel a creature to shield its mind. You choose a target within range. The target adds {@dice 1d6} to its next saving throw against fear or charm (including enchantment spells), then the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you reach certain levels you can lift the spirits of more than one creature: 2 at 5th level, 3 at 11th level, and 4 at 17th level.

spell.name: Magical Arrow
entries: You conjure a magical arrow and shoot it at a creature within range. You make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the arrow deals {@damage 1d8} piercing damage. This damage ignores resistance and immunity to piercing damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: The damage increases when you reach certain levels: 5th level ({@dice 2d8}), 11th level ({@dice 3d8}), and 17th level ({@dice 4d8}).

spell.name: Michelangelo's Alabaster Strike
entries: You choose an object within range that is between 1 to 5 pounds and choose a target. You make a ranged or melee spell attack. On a hit, the object strikes the target, and the target takes {@damage 1d6} + your spellcasting ability modifier bludgeoning damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: This spell's damage increases by {@dice 1d6} when you reach certain levels: 5th level ({@dice 2d6}), 11th level ({@dice 3d6}), and 17th level ({@dice 4d6}).

spell.name: Michelangelo's Marvelous Defense
entries: You summon the great Michelangelo's power and touch a willing creature; their body briefly resembles marble in hardness and strength, and when they take damage, it is reduced by {@dice 1d6+1}. Once damage is reduced in this way, the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: The spell's protection increases by {@dice 1d6} when you reach certain levels: 5th level ({@dice 2d6}), 11th level ({@dice 3d6}), and 17th level ({@dice 4d6}).

spell.name: Radiant Strike
entries: You summon radiant wrath from the skies and make a ranged attack roll against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d6} radiant damage or becomes {@condition blinded} until the start of your next turn (you choose to deal damage or make them blind). The cantrip deals an additional {@damage 1d6} damage to fiends and undead.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: This spell's damage increases by {@dice 1d6} when you reach certain levels: 5th level ({@dice 2d6}), 11th level ({@dice 3d6}), and 17th level ({@dice 4d6}).

spell.name: Reaping

m.text: a sharp object worth at least 1 cp

entries: Magical energy infuses your blade, and your target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 1d6} necrotic damage and gains the Decaying condition for the duration.

Decaying: The creature takes necrotic damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of its turns. It can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect early. Magical healing also ends the condition early. This condition can't be applied to undead and constructs.
If a creature has a Decaying condition, you can't use this cantrip on them.

spell.name: Rigid Strike
entries: You imbue a weapon held within range with arcane energy. The weapon deals {@damage 1d4} additional force damage and forces the creature to make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the target falls {@condition prone} if it is Large or smaller and the spell ends on the weapon.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: The damage increases when you reach certain levels: 5th level ({@dice 1d6}), 11th level ({@dice 1d8}), 17th level ({@dice 1d10}).

spell.name: Shards of Glass
entries: You are an expert of manipulating glass and its shards. You can create one of the following magical effects when you cast this cantrip:

entries.name: Conjure Glass
entries: You create an object made of glass that is not bigger than tiny and worth no more than 10 gp. The object stays intact for 10 minutes. If it's a weapon, you can wield it with the action you cast this spell, or using your action in subsequent turns with your spellcasting ability modifier and dealing {@damage 1d8} slashing damage with it. The weapon is counted as light. It also can be thrown (20/40 feet) at a creature or an object. When thrown, the glass shatters, and you choose a creature within 5 ft. of your target. It must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take half the damage you dealt to the original creature. When you throw it, the spell ends.

entries.name: Fix
entries: You can repair an object made of glass if it's broken. It can physically restore a magical item made from glass but can't restore its magical properties.

entries.name: Mirror
entries: You choose a surface no larger than 2 feet square. The surface magically becomes a mirror for 10 minutes. When you reach 5th level, while looking through the mirror, you are under the effects of the {@spell detect evil and good} spell. When you reach 11th level, you can duplicate the {@spell see invisibility} spell while looking through the mirror. When you reach 17th level, you can duplicate the effects of the sense spirit spell while looking through the mirror.

entries.name: Exploding Glass
entries: You target a nonmagical object made of glass or create one within range. It explodes and creatures within 5 feet of the object must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 1d10} slashing damage from the shards.
While an effect is active, you can't create another one. You can dismiss an active effect on your turn (no action required).

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d10} when you reach certain levels: 5th level ({@dice 2d10}), 11th level ({@dice 3d10}), 17th level ({@dice 4d10}).

spell.name: Subtle Strike
entries: You focus your gaze and attempt to send a devious arcane energy to a creature within range. You make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d6} psychic damage and can't speak until the end of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d6} when you reach certain levels: 5th level ({@dice 2d6}), 11th level ({@dice 3d6}), 17th level ({@dice 4d6}).

spell.name: Surgeon's Strike

m.text: a needle worth at least 1 cp

entries: You attack a creature as part of this cantrip and force it to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 1d4} piercing damage and the next attack against the target has {@variantrule Advantage|PHB} until the start of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: The damage increases by {@dice 1d4} when you reach certain levels: 5th level ({@dice 2d4}), 11th level ({@dice 3d4}), 17th level ({@dice 4d4}).

spell.name: Archaic Sense
entries: You focus your inner eye to detect life essence near you. For the duration, you detect any life form within 120 ft. of you (you can limit the range). However, the spell does not pinpoint the locations and types of creatures; it only gives numbers. You can exclude specific types of creatures: such as bugs, types of beasts, and similar before casting the spell to make it more effective.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a 2nd level spell slot, the range is doubled. For 3rd level or higher spell slots, the range increases by 1 mile for each spell slot level above the 2nd.

spell.name: Barbarossa's Tidal Heave

m.text: a melee weapon worth at least 1 cp

entries: You summon the power of the tides and hurl the weapon you hold at a target you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d8} damage + your spellcasting ability modifier. The damage type is the same as your weapon, but it is counted as magical. Whether it hits or misses, the weapon teleports back to your hand.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Barbarossa's Water Burst
entries: You choose two creatures within range and hurl a strong line of water with enough force to damage them. You have two options:

items: Force the creatures to make a Strength saving throw or they take {@damage 2d6} bludgeoning damage and are pushed 15 feet away. If they succeed, they only take half damage.
You alter the water and magically freeze it, and you make a separate ranged spell attack for all targets. On a hit, the hit target takes {@damage 2d8} cold damage.

entries: If you choose one target, you can't direct more than one effect.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a 2nd-level spell slot or higher, you can target one more creature for each slot level above the 1st.

spell.name: Copernicus's Quick Intervention

time.condition: which you take when a creature you can see within range rolls an initiative total below 10

entries: When a creature you can see rolls for initiative and rolls below 10, you summon the power of your foresight and add {@dice 1d8} to the roll.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd-level or higher, you can target one more creature for each slot level above the 1st.

spell.name: Dread
entries: You invoke the fear of death and undeath into a creature within range. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or it is {@condition frightened} of any undead. When it takes damage from any undead while the spell is active, it takes additional necrotic damage equal to {@damage 1d6}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

spell.name: Illusory Taunt
entries: You create an illusory image of yourself within range, which appears exactly like you. If it is hit by an attack roll or forced to make a saving throw, the responsible target takes {@damage 3d8} psychic damage. A successful Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check against your spell save DC reveals the illusion.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: False Trail
entries: You create an illusory image of the creature you touch that mimics its movements. You assign it a direction and when the original creature starts to move it does not leave any footprints or other traceable trails; instead the illusory image leaves those trails. Other than the direction it moves, it mimics exactly the creature you touch.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one more creature for each slot level above the 1st.

spell.name: Merchant's Ward
entries: An invisible magical ward appears on your head and protects you. For the duration, you have {@variantrule Advantage|PHB} on Wisdom checks to determine lies, and any check made to determine the quality of a trade good, an object or coins. In addition, you choose up to 50 pounds of goods that you can see within 30 feet of you. For the duration, if they are moved out of that location without your permission, you can track them and know where they are. However, if the customers pay for them, or you allow them to leave with the items (for example, as a token of charity), you can't track the items.

spell.name: Marvelous Performance

time.condition: which you take when you see a creature within 30 feet of you takes an action

entries: You magically distract the creature that is about to take an action. You force it to succeed on a Wisdom saving throw, or it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|PHB} on the action. If the action does not include a roll, the action is wasted because the creature spends its action staring at your performance.

spell.name: Moonflare
entries: You unleash a light filled with the moon's grace and with its power to reveal secrets. You make a ranged spell attack and deal {@damage 3d8} radiant damage on a hit. If the creature is a shapechanger, it is reverted to its original form and can't assume a new form until the end of its next turn.

spell.name: Object Relocation
entries: You hold a tiny object in your hand that does not weigh more than 10 pounds and choose a similar object that you can see within range that is not worn or carried. The objects magically swap places.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target up to one more object for each slot level above the first.

spell.name: Injection

m.text: a silver needle worth 25 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: While casting this spell, you magically fill a silver needle with liquid, a vial's worth maximum and it is considered one dose, for example if it's poison. For the duration you can make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 60 ft. that you can see. On a hit, the creature takes {@damage 1d8} force damage and the liquid is injected into the creature's bloodstream.
You must provide the liquid beforehand; it is not created with the spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a 2nd-level spell slot or higher, you can enchant one more silver needle for each spell slot above the 1st but you must provide necessary resources for each of them.

spell.name: Moongaze

m.text: powdered ember and silver costs 10 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: For the duration your eyes resemble a night radiated by the full moon. For the duration, you can discern shapechangers and illusions. You can end the spell early if you notice a shapechanger. You force it to make a Wisdom saving throw or it takes psychic damage equal to {@damage 1d8} + your spellcasting ability modifier. On a failed save, it reverts to its original form and can't assume a different form for 10 minutes.

spell.name: Natural Weapons

m.text: a fang of a beast, worth at least 10 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: You choose two creatures within range and grant them the ability of natural weapons like a predator's, such as sharp fangs or piercing claws. For the duration, they can use their unarmed strikes while replacing an attack. They can add your spellcasting ability modifier to their attack roll and damage rolls instead of Strength, and on a hit, the weapons deal {@damage 1d8} damage that is counted as magical (depending on the natural weapon's type, e.g. piercing for fangs), plus {@damage 1d8} acid damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell with a 2nd-level spell slot or higher you can target one more creature for each slot level above the 1st.

spell.name: Soulless Sphere
entries: You summon a veil that protects you and your companions from undead creatures. Any undead that looks at your direction or a space that falls within the sphere around you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or they detect you as undead creatures. Undead with 13 or more Intelligence are immune to this effect. Any magical effect or feature that determines your creature type renders you as undead. However, this doesn't mean they will not be hostile towards you; it is the GM's judgment.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a 3rd level or higher spell slot, the Intelligence limit becomes 15; if you cast it with a 5th level or higher spell slot; it becomes 17, and if you cast it with a 7th level or higher spell slot it becomes 21.

spell.name: Fragments of Death

m.text: a candle worth at least 25 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: You notice when an object is touched with death. For the duration, when you encounter an object whose owner is dead or any humanoid or beast that died within a month ever touched it, you feel it immediately. If you end the spell early with a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB|bonus action}, you can communicate with the fragments of the dead person and ask it two questions or spend 1 minute listening to it if you ask no questions. The fragment's answers may be cryptic and weird depending on the discretion of the GM, and the fragments are limited to when they last were in touch with the spirit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher you can increase the duration up to 1 minute or ask one more question for each slot level above the 1st.

spell.name: Shine Like a Star

m.text: a prop from a theater, worth at least 1 sp

entries: You weave the magic in art and award the effort of a performance with subtle magic. For the duration you have a +10 bonus to Charisma ({@skill Performance}) checks you made.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional humanoid for each slot level above 1st. The humanoids must be within 15 feet of each other when you target them.

spell.name: Swim
entries: Natural magic surrounds you while you faintly hear the sound of waves. You grant up to six creatures within range (which can include you) the ability to swim. The creatures gain a swimming speed of 40 feet for the duration. Additionally, the creatures can hold their breath twice the normal amount for the duration and can use their gear or objects which they are proficient with, without any difficulty.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher you can target up to two more additional creatures for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Whispering Death
entries: You whisper a word that contains the touch of death to a creature that you can see within range. You make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d8} necrotic damage. While you concentrate on the spell, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|PHB|disadvantage} on Constitution checks and saving throws. On subsequent turns while the spell is active, it damages the creature automatically ({@damage 1d8} necrotic damage). However, if you damage the target this way, it makes a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a successful save, the spell ends early.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a 2nd level spell slot or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each slot level above the 1st.

spell.name: Adept Ears
entries: For the duration, when you hear a statement, you can trigger a spellcasting ability check for yourself that you can make as a reaction. If your check succeeds against the creature's Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check (which the GM rolls in secret when this is triggered), you know if it's a lie or not. When you succeed in determining a statement's honesty three times, the spell ends early. On a failed save, it doesn't count against the number to end the spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a 3rd-level spell slot or higher, you can determine one additional statement's honesty for each slot level above the 2nd.

spell.name: Barbarossa's Cold Dispersion
entries: A sudden blast of cold emerges from a point that you can see within range in a 20-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in the sphere must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 2d6} cold damage and the ice covers their legs, dropping their movement speed to 0 ft for the duration.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a 3rd-level spell slot or higher the damage increases by {@dice 2d6} for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Deadly Embrace
entries: You touch a living creature and embrace it while forcing it to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it's {@condition grappled} by you and takes {@damage 1d6} necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns, the first damage dealt when it fails the saving throw. It can repeat the saving throw on each of its turns as an action to be free from the spell. If you are {@condition incapacitated} or you are farther within 5 ft. of the target, the spell ends early.
A creature killed by this spell rises as a {@creature poltergeist} controlled by you for 24 hours.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a 3rd-level spell slot or higher, its damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above the 2nd.

spell.name: Amplify Feelings
entries: Your magic subtly infused with your voice strengthens emotions in humanoids. Each humanoid within a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range must make a Charisma saving throw; a creature can choose to fail this saving throw if it wishes. If a creature fails its saving throw, you can choose an effect from below:

items: The creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|PHB|disadvantage} on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened} for the duration. If it is already {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}, the effect is amplified in a way chosen by the GM.

At the GM's discretion, already existing feelings and emotions of failed creatures are amplified, for example an instinct of protecting a pet may turn into a fiery desire to cause harm to anyone who dared to hurt it.

spell.name: Michelangelo's Buried Memories
entries: You touch a crafted object with artistic value and a resemblance to a humanoid, such as a statue, painting, trinket, or similar object. For the duration, you can access what they have witnessed in the past. You designate a time (such as yesterday at noon, last night at midnight, new year's eve, or the like) and you can see through the object's eyes and experience what it has seen in the designated timeline. You can use your action to change the time you designate. While concentrating on the spell, you can switch between your own senses and the object with a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB|bonus action}. While perceiving through the object, you are blind to your own senses.

Alternatively, you can perceive through the object at the moment if the object is within 1 mile of you. By the time the spell's duration ends, you can expend any spell slot as a reaction to increase its duration.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher its duration is extended by 10 minutes for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Manutius's Sturdy Objects

components.m: a tiny piece of black metal

entries: You touch an object that is not worn or carried, you grant it magical protection with the aid of Aldus Manutius, the founder of the Aldine Press. The object becomes immune to all damage for the duration.
If it is a weapon, it deals 1 additional force damage, or if it's armor, it reduces 1 damage each time the wearer takes damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a 3rd level spell slot or higher, you can target one more object for each spell slot above the 2nd.

spell.name: Mirror Magic

time.condition: which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of you casting a spell

entries: You copy the spell that you used as a trigger and cast it immediately. You use your own spellcasting abilities and you must expend a spell slot one level higher than the spell's level or higher while casting this spell. For example, if a creature casts {@spell fireball} spell as a 3rd-level spell, you must expend a 4th level spell slot or higher; otherwise the spell fails. If the creature is not willing, it must make a Wisdom saving throw from its spell being copied.

spell.name: Piri Reis's Endless Wind
entries: You summon the winds with a small prayer dedicated to the tides and the moonlight. You can use the power of the winds on windmills or ship sails. The chosen object is filled with winds and operates for the duration like normal. If there are objects that could be powered and operated using wind power, they can also be targeted by the spell at your GM's discretion.

spell.name: Machiavelli's Authority
entries: You utter the words of the prince, and your authority magically surrounds your enemy. It must make a Wisdom saving throw or you can choose one of the following commands (this spell requires Concentration, and its duration varies based on the command chosen):

items: Silence. The target can't speak until the start of your next turn, and then the spell ends. If it is concentrating on a spell, it immediately makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw to hold the concentration.
Stay Down. The target falls {@condition prone}, and it must make a Wisdom saving throw when it tries to get up for the next minute. When it does, the spell ends.

Stop Resistance. It uses its {@variantrule Reaction|PHB|reaction} to throw its weapon to the extent of its capabilities; then the spell ends. If it has no weapons, you can command it to throw an item it holds. If it holds no items, the spell fails.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional humanoid for each slot level above 2nd. The humanoids must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

spell.name: Quiet Orb
entries: You create a 15-foot radius orb at a point of your choosing. The borders of the orb appear shimmering and almost glass-like. No sound passes through its borders from inside to outside. The ones inside can hear the voices of the outside if you wish, but no sound reaches outside. You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB|bonus action} to move the orb up to 30 feet.

spell.name: Somber Orb
entries: You create a 15-foot radius orb at a point of your choosing. The borders of the orb appear opaque and almost made of adamantine. No light passes through its borders from inside to outside. The ones inside can see the outside if you wish, but no light reaches outside. You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB|bonus action} to move the orb up to 30 feet.

spell.name: Voice Change

components.m: a balloon filled with a non-toxic gas

entries: You magically alter your voice. You can choose a humanoid you have heard before, and your voice resembles theirs. However, any speech patterns or accents may be up to your abilities, and to copy a voice, you must know the language. An Intelligence check against your spell save DC may reveal the voice being made magically. As an action while the spell is active, you can change your voice to another individual or choose one of the following:

items: Bestial Sounds. You adopt the sound of a beast you have encountered before and mimic it exactly.

Devious Voice. Your voice resembles a creature that belongs to the underworlds and dark corners of the world. If you have encountered a fiend before, you can mimic its speech pattern, but you must know a language spoken by the fiends. It lasts for up to 1 minute, then the spell ends.

Angelic Tone. Your voice resembles an angelic creature of celestial origin. If you have encountered a celestial before, you can mimic its speech pattern but you must know a language spoken by the celestials. It lasts for up to 1 minute, then the spell ends.

Private Speech. You choose creatures up to your spellcasting ability modifier. When you speak, only they understand what you say exactly while other creatures around hear the words you choose. For each minute passed in private speech, you must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw to be able to continue the spell. Each minute increases the DC by 1.

spell.name: Barbarossa's Astonishing Repairs

m.text: a strong glue worth at least 250 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: You summon a great seafarer's power to repair damaged objects around you, such as a broken ship mast, a torn sail, a destroyed cannon, or similar. If the spell reaches its full duration, all the objects are repaired. In addition, you must stay within 300 feet of the point where you cast the spell.
The spell can psychically mend magical items or constructs but cannot restore magic to such an object.

spell.name: Dreamcatcher

m.text: a dreamcatcher made of special threads worth at least 50 gp

entries: You magically protect your companions' dreams and minds within range. You can choose which creatures to include in the spell. Affected creatures are protected while having a long rest. They can't be surprised, have {@variantrule Advantage|PHB} on saving throws, their minds cannot be read and have {@variantrule resistance|PHB} to all damage while having a long rest. Any effect or situation that would break a long rest will surpass the spell until the situation ends or you are {@condition incapacitated}. When the situation ends, the creatures do not have to start their long rest all over again, even if the spell's duration expires before that (this spell's actual duration varies depending on the rest, extending up to 8 hours or the completion of the rest).

spell.name: Glass Explosion
entries: You conjure exploding shards of glass on a point of your choice within range. Creatures within 15 feet of the point must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 6d6} slashing damage, or half as much on a successful one. The ones that fail receive the Wounded condition (see below).

Wounded. Unless you take a short or long rest or are applied a Medicine check (DC 10) or receive magical healing, you are considered Wounded. While Wounded, you take an extra {@damage 1d6} damage whenever you take slashing damage and your speed is reduced by 5 feet.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a 4th level spell slot or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above the 3rd.

spell.name: Majestic Performance
entries: You put on a magical performance for a brief moment. You force up to six creatures that you can see within range to succeed on a Wisdom saving throw, or they are forced to spend their next action staring at you magically. Creatures who are immune to the {@condition charmed} condition are immune to this spell as well.

spell.name: The Magnificent's Siege Weapons
entries: You choose two weapons and make the weapons magical. They deal double damage to objects and constructs.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a 4th level spell slot or higher, you can target one more weapon for each spell slot above the 3rd.

spell.name: Sense Intent
entries: You evoke your inner senses and determine the intent of humanoids around you. Each creature within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or the spell shows you their intentions with colors around them, which only you can see. Red for hostile intent, blue for friendly intent, purple for lust, green for sympathy, yellow for indifferent. Depending on the intentions, the GM may add new colors and inform you of their meanings.

spell.name: Piri Reis's Wonderful Navigation

m.text: a magnifying glass worth 100 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: You touch a creature and grant it incredible navigation skills to find a specific location. For the duration, the creature can't be lost, always knows where the location is, and can always predict the weather for the day if it spends 10 minutes listening to the winds.

The location must be known to you, or to the creature, or it should appear on a map with some accuracy. If you use a location from a map and you or the creature you cast the spell on do not know where the location is or have never seen the location, you must succeed on a DC 10 saving throw, which you make with your spellcasting ability. On a failed save, the spell fails. If the location is legendary or a myth, the spell also fails.

spell.name: Sense Spirit
entries: You focus on your connection with the wilds and enhance your awareness. Your eyes disregard any crafted object and only see what is natural. Within range, you see only spirits, rather than bodies and shells. Each spirit appears like a bright light, unless you force a spirit you see to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, you know the creature's type (e.g. fiend - imp) and the spell ends. If they succeed, you can't target the same creature again for 24 hours, but the spell does not end.

spell.name: Barbarossa's Floating Materials

components.m: a tiny ship made of watermelon rinds

entries: You choose flat objects within range that must cover at least a 5-foot-wide and 5-foot-long space and bind them together to act as a sailing vessel; the objects must have a width of at least 3-inches, such as wooden scraps, fabric parts, metallic plaques or similar. The created objects gain a swimming speed of 60 ft. and can be controlled by you if you spend a {@variantrule Bonus Action|PHB|bonus action}.
If the spell ends early, the scraps do not hold together and may be scattered around depending on the current, the waves, and the current speed of the vessel.
The duration can be extended by 1 hour if you expend at least a 2nd-level spell slot.

spell.name: Cursed Link
entries: You choose two creatures within range to share a connection between their souls. They both are forced to make a Constitution saving throw; a willing creature can choose to fail. On a failed save, their souls are cursed and linked with each other. If one of them takes damage, the other takes {@damage 4d6} necrotic damage, which can't be prevented in any way.

If a creature dies by this spell, you can maintain a connection with the spirit if you expend a 2nd-level spell slot after each long rest. While the connection remains, you can choose the spirit as one of the targets, and it automatically fails the saving throw. You can use your action to deal the spirit damage, thus damaging the other target as the spell suggests. If you do not expend a 2nd-level spell slot after a creature is dead by this spell for more than 24 hours, or if you do not expend a 2nd-level spell slot after other long rests, you must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, you can't use the creature as a target for the spell, but the spirit is not destroyed for another day. On a failed save, the spirit goes free.
While a spirit is trapped by this spell, it can't be resurrected. In addition, you can cast the {@spell speak with dead} spell on the spirit to talk to it.

spell.name: Ficino's Unity of the Soul
entries: You summon an aura to protect creatures around you from negative effects and create a near-invisible sphere around you. You choose any number of creatures within range. For the duration, the chosen creatures in the sphere are immune to the following conditions unless they choose to be affected: {@condition Blinded}, {@condition Charmed}, {@condition Deafened}, {@condition Frightened}, {@condition Grappled}, {@condition Incapacitated}, {@condition Invisible}, {@condition Paralyzed}, {@condition Petrified}, {@condition Poisoned}, {@condition Prone}, {@condition Restrained}, and {@condition Stunned}.

spell.name: Magical Outburst
entries: A magical wave of force strikes creatures within range. Each creature in the area except you is forced to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, they take {@damage 4d6} force damage and fall {@condition prone}. On a successful save, they take only half damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a 5th level spell slot or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 2d6} for each slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Disrupt One's Weave
entries: You touch a creature and attempt to cut its ties with the magic around it. It must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or can't cast spells and are not affected by spells for the duration. Anytime it casts a spell, uses a magic item, is targeted by a spell or forced to make a saving throw by a spell, it must repeat the saving throw. On a success, the spell ends but on a failure it takes {@damage 4d8} necrotic damage which can't be prevented or reduced in any way. If it's a construct, it loses its magic for the duration and counts as {@condition unconscious}.

spell.name: Binding Breath

m.text: a knot made of a prophet's hair knit for 40 days, worth at least 500 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: You control the lungs of four creatures within range and decide if they breathe or not. You force creatures to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they take damage equal to half of their current hit points and stop breathing for the duration and start suffocating.

spell.name: Force Eruption
entries: You unleash raw magical energy to attack creatures within range. Each creature in the area, except you, is forced to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, they take {@damage 6d6} force damage and are {@condition stunned} until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, they only take half damage.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a 7th level spell slot or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 2d6} for each slot level above the 6th. If you cast this spell with an 8th-level or 9th-level spell slot, you knock creatures {@condition unconscious}.

spell.name: Cutting Edge

m.text: a sharp razor made of silver worth at least 100 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: You touch a weapon that can deal slashing damage. If not magical, the weapon becomes one for overcoming resistance and immunities against nonmagical slashing damage. For the duration, it can cut any object that is not worn or being carried into two, depending on what the weapon is aimed at. For example, it could cut a pillar that supports a building and could damage the building's integrity by doing so. The cut halves look like they are severed by magical flames.

In addition, when the weapon hits a creature, the wielder can choose one of the options if the mentioned objects are not magical: Cut the shield, cut the armor, or cut the weapon. The said object becomes useless, for example a nonmagical plate armor does not work for the creature.

{@spell Barbarossa's Astonishing Repairs|EchoesOfRenaissance} spell can mend the objects. In addition, if the {@spell mending} cantrip is cast as a 10-minute ritual and by expending a 4th level spell slot, it can also fix the objects.

spell.name: Phantom Body
entries: You touch a humanoid and transform its body into a phantom. For the duration, the creature is counted as undead; it stops aging; its body becomes spectral; it can move through solid objects and creatures; it has a flying speed of 40 ft; and it gains the following features:
Damage Resistances. acid, fire, lightning, thunder, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing.
Damage Immunities. cold, necrotic, poison.

Condition Immunities. {@condition charmed}, {@condition exhaustion}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition grappled}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition petrified}, {@condition poisoned}, {@condition prone}, {@condition restrained}.
When it makes an attack, it deals additional necrotic damage equal to {@damage 3d6} and restores hit points equal to the highest of the d6 rolls.
If it finishes its turn inside a solid object, it takes {@damage 2d10} force damage; the spell ends early, and it is teleported into the nearest unoccupied space.

spell.name: Unmake the Undeath

m.text: dusted emeralds worth at least 5,000 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: You touch a {@condition restrained} undead creature and call it back to freedom. For the casting of the spell, the creature must remain within your reach and must remain {@condition restrained}. When the spell is cast, the creature's soul is freed from its undead grasp. However, the spell does not revive the creature from death. The body can be revived with proper spells, if the condition is appropriate, such as its body is intact and the time period has not elapsed.

spell.name: Draconic Gift

m.text: a gemstone survived a dragon's breath, worth at least 500 gp, which the spell consumes

entries: You touch a humanoid and its form changes to Huge, scales appear on its body, and you choose a dragon type for it: black, blue, green, red, white, brass, bronze, copper, gold, or silver. You choose an adult dragon's feature and the target adopts it for the duration. The features can be found in a dragon's statblock, such as Amphibious, Legendary Resistance, Lightning Breath, Frightful Presence, Weakening Breath and the like. In addition, the target gains a flying speed of 80 ft.

spell.name: Youth
entries: You attempt to strike a creature within their very soul and link each others' spirits. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 5d12} necrotic damage or half as much on a successful one. If the spell kills the target, you get younger and absorb its soul energy. The maximum amount you can get younger is equal to the damage dealt represented as years. By doing so, the soul is consumed and destroyed.

If the soul is not in the same alignment as you, you must make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or your alignment changes to the creature's alignment and you retain some of its memories, at the discretion of the GM.

spell.name: Absolute Fear
entries: You force a creature that you can see within range to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you choose a concept, a creature, an object or anything the GM deems appropriate. The creature is permanently {@condition frightened} of it. Only a {@spell wish} spell or a divine method beyond mortal comprehension can end this spell's effects on a creature.

spell.name: The Magnificent's Authority
entries: You issue an order to a creature that you can see within range. If it is within their capabilities, they use their next action to complete the order. The order must be one that can be completed within an action. If the order includes casting a spell (e.g.: “cast {@spell fireball} on that scarecrow”), the spell can be no higher than 7th level. If the order is one which would bring immediate harm to the creature, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw to reject the order. For example, if the order is “jump off that bridge,” then the creature gets to roll a Wisdom saving throw to resist; however, if the order is “slap that guard in the face,” then the order must be carried out if it can be done in an action (i.e. if the guard is within the creature's distance). A creature with immunity to being {@condition charmed} is immune to this spell.

spell.name: Al-Jazari's Practical Summons
entries: You conjure a solid and non-magical object that you have seen before within range. The object must be Large or smaller, and its price must not exceed 150 gp. The object must not go further than 15 ft. from you, or it disappears immediately. The object disappears at the end of the spell's duration.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can conjure one more item equal to the slot's level.

item.name: Amulet of da Vinci
entries: While attuned to this amulet, twice a day you can cast the {@spell fabricate} spell as an action and without expending a spell slot twice a day. You regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

item.name: Amulet of Laughter
entries: The amulet has a carved face with a smile on it and has three charges. If you spend a charge while wearing it and touch a creature who is {@condition charmed}, the condition is removed.

In addition, you can expend a charge to target a creature within 15 ft. of you and force it to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC (if you do not have one, your DC for this amulet becomes 8 + your WIS Modifier + your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, it bursts into laughter until the start of your next turn. This laughter does not affect the creature's regular actions, such as making an attack, but it can't say anything and can't cast spells with verbal components.

item.name: Barbarossa's Ring
entries: The ring has five charges, which are restored at dawn when expended. You can use an action to expend a charge and cast one of these spells: {@spell fog cloud}, {@spell ice storm}, {@spell control water}, {@spell water walk}, {@spell water breathing}, {@spell cone of cold}, or a spell with Barbarossa's or Piri Reis's name on it. In addition, your attacks deal additional cold damage equal to {@dice 1d8} + your Wisdom modifier. The spells use your spell save DC and spell attack bonus.

item.name: Doge's Mask
entries: The mask made of wood appears to be very simple in design and shape, only to cover one's face without much flourish. While attuned to it and wearing it, you can cast {@spell alter self} at will, without expending a spell slot. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

item.name: Historian's Ring
entries: Adorned with owl feathers and enchanted with scholarly magic, this ring gives the following ability while attuned to it: you double your proficiency bonus on the History skill. Additionally, if you ever read something, you do not forget it.

item.name: Magnificent's Signet
entries: This magic ring is adorned with Ottoman Turkish carvings and carries the sign of Suleiman the Magnificent. While attuned to this item, your Charisma score is 21, if it is not higher already, and you can cast each the following spells at will: {@spell command}, {@spell compelled duel}, {@spell hold person}, {@spell quiet orb|EchoesOfRenaissance}, and {@spell hold monster}.

item.name: Miraculous Shield
entries: This magical shield once belonged to the sultan of Fez and is said to protect its owner at any cost. Legends say that if the radiant crystal in its core shines bright like the sun, it is usually time to escape. While worn this shield works like a +2 shield. While attuned to this shield and while it is equipped, you can cast the {@spell shield} spell without expending a spell slot.

item.name: Piri Reis's World Map
entries: This map of the world enables you to cast {@spell teleport}, the destination of which is the place you put your hands on the map, without any of the drawbacks of the spell.
