footnotes: If there is any modifier next to your result, add this modifier to your roll in the Your Past Education table.

table.name: The Relationship Your Community Has to the Arcane
rows: You come from a community which doesn’t believe in any kind of magic.
You come from a community which believes in the supernatural as much as any other. Their belief is usually superstitious and far from the truth.

You come from a community which somehow knows there are things beyond the veil of mortal eyes. Perhaps some in the community have access to the simplest of spells - but they most certainly keep their gift or curse out of sight.

You come from a community which has experienced something supernatural. They may have felt the power of Al-Ghaib firsthand, encountered some monstrous adversaries or allies, or hosted people of some arcane prowess in ages past.
You come from a community which not only knows the arcane arts, but harnesses its powers somehow.{@sup 1}
You come from a community which devoted itself to searching and investigating powers of arcane, dark arts, or that of Al-Ghaib. This adventure is your fate, there is no doubt about that.{@sup 2}
footnotes: {@sup 1}When rolling for life experiences, roll one extra. This extra must be an Arcane Event.
{@sup 2}When rolling for life experiences, roll one extra. This extra must be a Catastrophic Arcane Event.

table.name: How Did Your Arcane Abilities First Manifest
rows: You have inherited magic; your family is part of a long line of spellcasters.
You stumbled upon a magical artifact, and one day it spoke to you, promising power and fame in exchange for a small favor.
You witnessed a miracle as a child and devoted your life to learning the arcane.
You were adopted by a powerful mage and diligently studied under their tutelage until you chose to forge your own path.
You were standing too close to an arcane explosion and absorbed its power.
One night, you were abducted and found yourself being experimented on. You managed to escape with your newfound powers.
You drank an unknown potion instead of alcohol, and something awakened within you.
You wronged a mage and became cursed.
You were bitten by a monster, and the residue of its magic remained within you.
Someone reached out to you in your dreams. The next day, you woke up with arcane abilities.

table.name: Your Past Education
intro: Education is a key factor in your life’s journey. The World of Historica Arcanum is a magical and fantastic place, sure. However, this world is rooted in real history. Getting a proper education is rare and very valuable.
rows: Below 1
You have little to no education.
Your only way of education is from an apprenticeship at an early age / Gain a tool proficiency.
You are educated enough through unorthodox ways (Strangers, your family, the community you live in, random books that you find) / Gain a musical instrument or a game set proficiency.
You got an appropriate education from an institution of learning like a university or a madrasah / Gain a language proficiency.
You are well educated thanks to private tutors / Gain two language proficiencies.
You are exceptionally well-educated. A royal academy or a true master taught you the secrets of this world / Gain a language and a skill proficiency. This skill must be an Intelligence check.

table.name: Life Events by Age
intro: You are an adventurer. Regardless of your age, you have experienced some unusual circumstances for sure. However, as you grow older and travel around, your experience of this extraordinary world widens.
rows: 20 years or younger
21 - 30 years
31 - 40 years
41 - 50 years
51 - 60 years
61 years or older
footnotes: Choose one of the options below:
{@b Well Traveled:} You traveled a lot–seen many places, met many people. Roll one more Life Event.
{@b Deep Rooted:} You worked and struggled in the same place for years. Start your adventure with 15 extra gd.

table.name: Life Events
rows: Unbeknownst to you, your significant other has been working for the enemy.
After a horrible accident, you were stripped of your rank in the army.
You embarked on a lengthy journey, and upon your return, your family was nowhere to be found.
You fell deeply in love, only to discover that they were a ghost.

You have been followed by the same heron throughout your entire life. It appears to desire something specific from you, but it is unable to communicate (the {@spell speak with animals} spell reveals that the heron is speaking in Etruscan).
You have never experienced a single dream throughout your entire life. Suddenly, you find yourself within a dream, and a voice is calling you to come and find them.
You have witnessed a horrifying murder, yet the victim returned to your village the following day with a sinister grin on their face.

Throughout your entire life, you have been catching glimpses of a veiled figure just at the corner of your eyes, a presence that no one else seems to perceive. Since “it” happened, the figure has disappeared.
One day, you woke up in a different body and found yourself in an unfamiliar place where no one recognized you, not even yourself.
You made the foolish decision to deceive one of the most influential businessmen in your region and have been in hiding ever since.
You discovered an incredibly valuable gem, yet you are the sole individual able to perceive it.
You stumbled upon a buried parchment that purportedly holds the world's secrets, but it's written in a language that no one seems to recognize.
You found yourself burdened with an incredibly heavy debt to an aristocrat, leading to the kidnapping of your friends for ransom.
Someone has stolen your beloved dog, and you are now on a quest for revenge.
A con artist made a promise to double your entire sum of money if you entrusted it to them. However, they lost it all, resulting in your family disowning you.

Just before your mentor's passing, they disclosed the existence of a substantial hidden treasure that could guarantee wealth for generations in your lineage. Unfortunately, they forgot to specify the exact location before their demise, leaving you with the knowledge that it's somewhere in the vicinity of Venice.

Your community holds the belief that you were the chosen child destined to bring them greatness. However, you actually switched places with your twin sibling, who was the true chosen one. As the pressure from the community continues to mount, you are compelled to locate your twin, who was sent to live with your aunt many years ago.
Unbeknownst to you, a fairy has fallen in love with you. You can't fathom why you're incredibly fortunate in every facet of your life except for matters of the heart.
Throughout your life, you've received telepathic messages from an unknown source. While you've been able to witness what they see, pinpointing their location has been an enigma. Until now.

You formed a close friendship with a mimic whose sole delight is to listen to stories. Resembling a mirror in shape, you carry this mimic with you. In return for sharing captivating tales, the mimic vowed to safeguard you, and this unique bond thrives as long as you continue to feed it with engaging narratives.
You find yourself recalling memories that don't belong to you – these are remnants from your previous life when you possessed great power.

One day, a door materialized within your house, a door that had not previously existed. Despite your persistent attempts, it remained resolutely sealed. Curiously, intricate carvings adorned its surface, guiding your attention to a church in Venice. It became evident that this church might hold the key to unlocking the door's secrets.

As the offspring of one of the most prominent families in your hometown, you are entangled in a longstanding vendetta between your family and another. In a bid to preserve a fragile peace, you were designated as a sacrificial pawn. However, you managed to elude this grim fate and escape.

After a ritual gone wrong, you are now stuck with a completely useless and incredibly annoying demon by your side, who steadfastly refuses to assist you in any manner. However, they prove to be an exceedingly intriguing character.

Having struck a life-saving agreement with a dragon, you are now obligated to periodically locate new lairs for them, lest the dragon follow through on their promise to consume you in a most gruesome manner.
You repeatedly encounter individuals who bear an uncanny resemblance to you, yet the moment your eyes meet, they hastily flee. Despite your efforts, you have never managed to catch up to any of them.

Abducted as a child for ransom, your family's apparent indifference led your captor to raise you as a fellow criminal. In an unexpected turn, they proved to be the best parental figure you could have hoped for.

A curse cast upon you by a fairy has had an unexpected outcome. Instead of rendering you unlovable, it has made everyone perceive you as incredibly adorable, increasing your Charisma score to 17, if it isn’t higher already.
Your reflection has gained sentience, representing the most exasperating aspects of your personality. As a result, you actively evade mirrors and any reflective surfaces.

Each time you drift into slumber, your mind immerses itself in incredibly lifelike dreams that unfold as if they were reality. Unknown to you, you are astral projecting during these moments, yet your abilities remain beyond your control. You had never realized this until you saw a familiar face.

For a significant duration, you served as the right-hand person to a satrap. However, your position was terminated after you delivered an incorrect message that jeopardized their identity. Consequently, your memories were erased, and you were left to navigate your path independently. Nevertheless, intermittent flashes of your former life manage to resurface in your consciousness.

One fateful day, you awoke from a profound slumber to find a knife clenched in your hands and your entire family brutally slaughtered. As you hurriedly stepped outside in a state of panic, the horrifying reality became apparent: your entire village had been mercilessly slaughtered. Since that harrowing moment, you've been in a constant state of evasion, fleeing from the law.

You had been employed by an amoral mercenary leader for years. Your employer saw no problems in slaying children, burning villages, or torturing ordinary people. When you were already fed up with him, he learned the hard way that he should not push your buttons. Now that you have killed their leader, the whole mercenary gang is trying to hunt you down.

Having undergone rigorous training among a group of sellswords, you stood on the brink of receiving your inaugural assignment. Yet fate intervened when you overheard your patron unveiling the true character of the individual you were meant to eliminate. That very night, you made your escape, vowing never to return to that path.

Your master endeavored to ensnare a djinni within a bottle, similar to Aladdin's tale, yet the magic misfired, incarcerating you within the vessel instead. Accompanying your master, you embarked on a global quest to unearth a means of liberation. Only upon his demise did you finally escape the confines of the bottle, reemerging in Venice.

Once a soldier within Barbarossa’s naval fleet, you found yourself in the throes of a tumultuous night of revelry. As morning broke, you awoke to discover that your ship had set sail without you, leaving you stranded in an unfamiliar land. Bereft of any means to return home, you now face the daunting task of navigating this foreign territory.

Raised within the opulent confines of one of Venice’s leading family’s many palaces, your life took a grievous turn several years back. Due to a mere rumor, your father and your entire family were exiled from the city, forcing you to relinquish your privileged status. Since then, you've been navigating the unfamiliar realm of the common folk, endeavoring to find your place in this new world.
Your heart stopped when you were a child, leading to your death and subsequent rebirth. Ever since then, you have possessed the ability to see people who remain unseen by others.
You nursed an injured stray puppy back to health. From that day on, you have gained a loyal friend who was there for you in all your adventures.

When you were a teen, you were kidnapped by an entity of draconic origin and set aside to be food later on. However, upon seeing your birthmark, the creature let you go. Ever since, you have wondered what was so special about your birthmark that you were spared that day.
Your mother was a beloved witch and healer of your village. When witch hunters killed her, you vowed revenge.
You were experimented on by a group of scholars within the Vatican. They kidnapped you and subjected you to torturous experiments, resulting in serious trauma and the acquisition of arcane powers.

Every year, one person from your village goes missing for a few days and returns with a changed appearance, sporting a completely different face and character. They resume their daily routines as if nothing has happened. No one but you seems to notice these changes. You didn't pay much attention to this phenomenon until your sister came back with a new face.

One day, you are stopped by a strange old person. Tears are streaming down their face, and they keep telling you how much they love you. No matter how many times you ignore them or try to get rid of them, they keep finding you. They tell you that you haven't met them yet, but when you do, you'll fall in love, too.
After winning a bet against a warlock, out of anger from losing, he told you that you have been cursed to die while riding on a gondola. You have been avoiding gondolas ever since.

While living in Venice, you were digging up your floor to build a stronger foundation for your new house. However, the area you dug revealed a skeleton stuck among the foundation poles which appears to have been dead for a long time. As a result, their soul became bound to you, and they now accompany you wherever you go. Only you have the ability to see him, and he is quite a stubborn individual.

You served as the food tester for the pope. One day, while you were completely unaffected, the pope suddenly died. It was later revealed that the pope had been allergic to a spice that you were not allergic to. Despite your innocence, you were blamed for the incident and narrowly escaped being beheaded.

You were abducted by a cult with the intention of being sacrificed. Just moments before they could carry out the act, an invisible power intervened and mercilessly wiped out the entire cult. Miraculously, you emerged as the sole survivor of that fateful day. However, the remaining members of the cult, those who did not attend that particular ritual, hold you responsible for the devastation, and now they are relentlessly hunting you down.

For centuries, tales have circulated about a family heirloom prophesied to bestow wealth and power upon the entire lineage, should it ever be found. This legendary artifact is said to be housed within the sestiere of San Marco. Despite being dismissed as mere bedtime stories for generations, you made the daring decision to embark on a quest to locate it.
Throughout your entire life, you've kept seeing the spirit of a former Doge, now deceased, everywhere you go. It was somewhat easy to ignore him until the day he finally spoke to you.

Having managed to escape from a slave trade route, you find yourself on the run, evading pursuit. Though your time in captivity was brief, you overheard a few conversations regarding arcane knowledge that could prove invaluable in your current circumstances.

Operating covertly as a monster hunter, you maintain the façade of a lumberjack in your official role. However, individuals who are aware of your true nature engage your services to safeguard against these creatures.

Upon the passing of your parents, you stumbled upon a letter hidden within your home. To your astonishment, the letter unveils a long-held secret: you were abducted as a child and raised under false pretenses by your parents. The letter repeatedly alludes to your father's immense power, tempered by a lurking danger. However, it withholds the true identity of your father, leaving you with a cryptic trail of clues to decipher. Determined to unveil the truth, you embark on a mission to follow the hints provided in the letter and finally uncover your father's identity.

For years, your sister persistently claimed to be the wife of the Doge. Her assertions, however, were met with disbelief, and many considered her to be delusional. Despite her pleas falling on deaf ears, one fateful night, a contingent of soldiers arrived and forcibly took her away. You have been looking for her ever since.

Your father held a distinguished position as a prominent knight within the doge’s court. His life was tragically cut short by a mysterious and unsolved murder, leaving his killer's identity concealed. In the course of your journey, you discovered his cherished dagger among his belongings. Strangely, from the moment you took hold of the dagger, an extraordinary connection was forged – enabling you to perceive your father's presence. Through this ethereal link, he shared the identity of his murderer and his unquenchable thirst for retribution.

(If the PC is older than 40 years old) The love of your life, an unforgettable figure who left an indelible mark on your heart, was a summer romance that blossomed during your youthful years. This person embodied all your desires and dreams. Yet, inexplicably, they vanished from your life without a single trace. However, recent events have taken an astonishing turn. A wandering painter happened upon your village not long ago, their canvases displaying a range of scenes. To your astonishment, one of these paintings depicted your long-lost love, frozen in time, bearing no signs of aging. This artwork was crafted merely months ago in the sestiere of Castello.

You have discovered a map that displays the locations of treasures. Every time you unearth a treasure, a new marking appears on the map. You've been diligently following the map to discover treasure chests and jewelry, which you intend to sell to sustain yourself. This marks the first instance where the marking, situated on the Island of San Giorgio Maggiore, is twice as large as the previous ones.

You had served as a palace entertainer for many years. However, you were sold to another noble and were in transit to your new destination. Tragically, during the journey, your chaperone suffered a heart attack and passed away. As a result, you find yourself stranded in an unfamiliar land.

You were raised by a single mother on the outskirts of a small village. The house you moved into had been abandoned for some time due to its haunted reputation. However, your mother didn't mind, and neither did you, because the ghosts residing in the house became your closest friends and essentially raised you. You made a promise to these spirits that you would find a way to bring them back to life. This promise has become your life's purpose.

You have carved out a livelihood by studying the stars and unraveling their hidden meanings. The constellations and their arrangements serve as your guide to foreseeing what lies ahead. Individuals from around the globe seek your insights to gain a glimpse into their future. One fateful day, you received a summons from a princess.

Throughout your life, you held onto an imaginary friend. Even as you matured, this companionship remained unbroken. As time advanced and your features became more defined, you gradually noticed an uncanny resemblance between your imaginary friend and an older iteration of yourself.

You have discovered a thick notebook among the belongings of your late father. It had belonged to your grandfather, who was evidently an adventurer, and these are the logs of his escapades. Within its pages, a few unfinished quests remain, which could possibly be undertaken even today.

Abducted and raised by a healer warlock in the heart of a forest, you were released to forge your own path upon reaching adulthood. As years flowed by, a startling realization settled in – the whereabouts of the warlock who had raised you had slipped from your memory entirely. The knowledge of your true parents remained a mystery, and the yearning to unearth your origins intensified.

Once a prosperous caravan master, wealth flowed through your veins. However, a harsh period of relentless security breaches and a chilling assassination attempt shattered your world. Faced with no recourse, you made the daring choice to orchestrate your own demise and slip into the shadows of hiding. Now, consumed by the need for answers, you are determined to unveil the hands that stole your life from you.

You have found an old book. It seems that someone has written a long novel about the protagonist's life story. The first few chapters eerily resemble your life. In the fifth chapter, it exactly matches your life. As the story moves along, the character sets out on a long journey that changes their life.
You are a priest and you have been assigned to a new church in the unfamiliar land of Venice.

Among the belongings of your late mother, you have found a worn-down pile of letters. They were written by your father, whom you have never met. It seems as though he had been sending funds to your mother for your care and inquiring about your life. You notice that the letters have been signed by a knight. Filled with curiosity, you decide to find him, hoping that you might inherit his knighthood when he passes.
You had been a servant who dared to offend the Doge. Prior to your execution, an old friend orchestrated your escape. Now, you are wanted by the palace and find yourself on the run.

Raised in a cult your entire life, you were devoted to its beliefs. One night, you were abruptly awakened by whispers outside your door. Inexperienced cult members had been assigned to capture you for an upcoming ritual sacrifice. Their panic was evident. Seizing the opportunity presented by their incompetence, you managed to escape. However, you remain uncertain whether the cult is still actively searching for you or not.

You were an incredibly talented calligrapher. One day, you received a special pen as a gift and were instructed to use it only on special occasions. Upon using the pen, you realized that it possessed arcane powers. The things you wrote with the pen had a tendency to come true, although the effects were limited to minor things. Just as you were becoming adept at using the pen and achieving more significant miracles, it was stolen from you. The only distinctive detail you could recall about the thief was their bright red hair. Now, your sole aspiration in life is to recover your stolen pen.

You have spent years working as a guide for trade ships. As your master's retirement approaches, you are poised to take over the business. However, there is another candidate vying for the same position. Both of you have been striving to maintain a favorable relationship with your master and seize any available business opportunities. The most recent assignment involved leading a ship to Venice. Surprisingly, your rival allowed you to take charge of this task without any dispute.

Due to your frequent work-related travels, you found yourself forming separate families in three different cities. On a particular day, as you were about to enter one of your homes, a chilling sight met your eyes: all three of your partners stood there, their gazes filled with vengeance.

Having been betrayed by your closest friend, you've been consumed by a desire for revenge. You've been on a quest to settle the score for a while now. The most recent information places them in Venice.
As a highly skilled painter specializing in religious murals, you have received a prestigious commission. Your task involves creating a mural for a church located in Venice.

From a young age, you have been deeply immersed in the teachings of the sea. Integrating music into your journeys, you've skillfully played the oud and earned a revered place among your crew’s musicians. However, as time passed, you felt a calling to visit the places where art flourished. This inner urging led you to embark on a meaningful journey.

In the lands that ruled by the Ottoman Empire, you served as an alchemist in a manor, spending years trying to uncover the mysteries of the universe for patrons whose values clashed with your own. Having had enough, you orchestrated your escape and are, finally, free.

You were a well-established priest. One day, a person came to your church for confession, wearing a mask. They began talking about their life and started coming for confession every week. However, you never knew who they were. As they spoke, you found yourself falling deeply in love with them. One day, during a confession, they revealed that they would be moving to Venice and that this would be the last time you would see them. Unable to banish them from your thoughts, you are determined to uncover their true identity.

You had a happy home with your partner and child. It was a peaceful sanctuary until that fateful day when individuals from the palace arrived and abducted your child. Your partner was slain as they attempted to intervene. Now, all that consumes your thoughts is vengeance and the determination to locate your missing child.
For years, you have been striving to initiate a revolution, but unfortunately, nobody is willing to join your cause.

You have been the owner of a bookstore for years. The best part about your store is the fact that it is immensely haunted. However, all the ghosts that live there are truly intriguing scholars and writers who simply didn't want to depart from the world of literature. One day, one of the ghosts opens up to you about how they died. Now, all you want to do is seek revenge on their behalf.

You were the son of a noble. When your father passed away, your brother assumed the leadership, and tried to eliminate you to ensure there would be no one else to claim the heritage. However, you managed to escape before he could carry out his intentions.

You had a profound purpose in life and were willing to go to any length to attain it. You came remarkably close to achieving your goal. However, right as you were on the verge of obtaining what you desired, you had an epiphany and recognized that you were, in fact, the antagonist. Overwhelmed by this realization, you chose to abandon everything in order to seek redemption for your wrongdoings.
You are a very accomplished cartographer, and your life's goal is to create an accurate map of the islands within Venice.

You are a famous bard. Someone has stolen your name and is using your reputation. Their songs are not as good, but because of your fame, they are making great money even though their performances are subpar. You have decided to catch them in the act. You follow them around, going to their last known locations, but you always seem to be one step behind.

You have lost all your memory, and you don't even remember who you are. Your last bits of memories are returning to you in flashes. In your last memory, you are sitting in a hut, sipping tea, while a great church looms in the distance with a very distinct bell.
Your biggest desire was to join Barbarossa’s naval fleet and prove yourself, but you were deemed unfit. After months of training, you will show all who doubted you that you have what it takes.
Your mother believed you to be a saint and protected you your whole life, preparing you for your eternal duty. After her demise, you set out for Venice to fulfill your destiny.
The love of your life ran off on the night of your wedding with another person. They were last seen heading to Venice. Your revenge awaits you in the city.

A traveling merchant announced themselves as a servant of the doge to you. They convinced you that you made the best potato soup in all the realms and should be awarded for it. He told you that word was sent to the doge and he awaits you to give you riches and a medal for your marvelous work. At first you didn’t believe it, but after being encouraged by your entire village you set out for Venice to collect your rewards.
After years of non-communication, your estranged father sent you a letter. He was locked up in Venice because of a misdemeanor and pleads with you to come save him.
On a drunken night, you found yourself in bed with a noble family member. You ran off to join a pirate crew and sail to the high seas to save your head.
The last few months have been lost to you, as if your brain was under command of someone else. You woke up on a ship, not knowing why you’re there or where you’re headed.
You have been running away from someone your whole life. A long life…you have run so long that you forgot who you were running from. But run you must. That’s all you’ve known.
For the past year, an incredibly vivid dream has been haunting you. You see yourself looking down on Venice, holding the hands of your future partner. You know this is where your happiness lies.

You have been bought off of your parents by some pirates. During one night of debauchery, they loosened their watch over you, and you ran off until you snuck into a ship that’s headed towards God knows where.

You have been possessed by a fairy but you eventually became good friends, because it made your life better and eventually stopped possessing you. All along, it was feeling sorry for you and decided to help you to improve the quality of your life.

You made a bargain with a local seer to use his powers for gain, but on one of the darkest nights, you approached his house and heard him talking to some weird crystal ball and a vicious voice answering. You ran away and have not looked back since.

Your ship sailing through the Mediterranean wrecked on a small and probably uncharted island. You spent months there, and you were sure there were other people who tried to hurt you but you never met one of them. Eventually, a ship passing by saved you but you never shook the feeling of being watched.

You found an interesting compass from a stranger in the market. The compass led you to a tree-house, and you found a lamp in it. There was a creature in the lamp that declared that it could grant you a wish. You accidentally wished for some nonsense, a very simple thing; it actually happened, but you never heard of the creature again.

You defeated gods, slain dragons, fought off ancient krakens at sea, and wrestled giants at the top of the clouds. Or so you thought until you were put in a mental institution proper to the area you live. You were eventually healthy enough to be released, or did you imagine that as well?

You saw a mage conjure some kind of otherworldly entity.
You witnessed a magical healing spell. You saw an arm regrow in seconds.

You witnessed powerful magic being cast by a wizard. The spell rebound was terrible: there were bodies everywhere.
You saw a portal leading to Al-Ghaib. Just by looking through it, you fell into madness. This madness lasted for 1 whole year. You have no memory of that time.
You died. It makes no sense that you still draw breath. What happened?

You fought in a lot of battles. Then you took an arrow in the knee.

entries.name: Foreword
entries: Dear Readers,

When we launched {@i The City of Crescent} on August 23, 2021, I didn't fully understand what kind of road we were stepping onto. Back then, Metis Creative was a small team with a big dream: to tell stories that mattered, to build worlds that would stay with people long after the dice stopped rolling. We were fueled by passion, but we were also at the very beginning of learning what it truly meant to create, to grow, and to endure.

Since that day, so much has changed. We have worked with more than thirty incredible individuals. We've changed offices three times. We have weathered economic storms, supply chain breakdowns, and challenges too many to name. We have launched four TTRPGs and one board game, each one teaching us lessons we couldn't have learned any other way. Through it all, we kept moving forward—sometimes sprinting, sometimes stumbling—held together by the love of what we do, the fascination we have for stories, for history, and for the worlds we dream into life.

{@i Echoes of Renaissance} represents a new chapter in that journey of growth. It is the first time we stepped outside the comfort of our own culture to honor another. We set out to capture the spirit of the Italian Renaissance—not just its beauty and spectacle, but its tensions, its fractures, and its haunting undercurrents. It was a challenge that asked more from us than any project before, demanding a deeper understanding, a greater sensitivity, and a higher standard for the kind of creators we strive to be.

Creating this book has made me reflect on how much Metis Creative has grown. Not just in skill or ambition, but in heart. We are no longer just trying to make games—we are trying to make lasting worlds, to leave something behind that feels alive, that resonates.

I have the rarest privilege in the world: to build these dreams with the most talented team I could ever imagine, and to share this adventure with a business partner who makes every step possible. I owe them everything, and I owe you—the reader, the player, the dreamer—my deepest thanks.
We are still growing. Still learning. Still daring to believe that the best stories are the ones worth fighting for.
Thank you for being a part of this journey. I hope {@i Echoes of Renaissance} will stay with you, the same way making it will always stay with me.
With gratitude,
{@b Doğa Can Sayılkan}
{@i Creative Director, Metis Creative}

entries.name: Linguistic Terms
entries: Throughout this adventure we use some words from a variety of languages to help bring the story to life, though we try not to go too overboard so that we don't obfuscate the narrative. With that being said, we wanted to give you the meanings of some of the most common words in one easy-to-find location to avoid confusion and aid gameplay. The common ones used are in Italian (the modern language based on the medieval Tuscan dialect), Venetian, and Ottoman Turkish. For more information about the city of Venice and the world of the late Renaissance, see our companion setting guide, Echoes of Renaissance.

entries.caption: Italian and Venetian
rows: Campo
A small city square in Venice (plural: campi).
Ca'
Abbreviation of casa, meaning 'home.' It is basically synonymous with palazzo (see below), but is a more polite term to distinguish a noble palace from the Doge's Palace.
Cortile
Courtyard
Doge
The elected leader of Venice.
Fondamenta
The bank along the canals where people walk. Literally 'foundation' (plural: fondamente)
Palazzo
Palace, a word used to describe not only the Doge's Palace (Palazzo Ducale) but also the residences of wealthy patricians.
Piano
Floor (of a home).
Piazza
City square. There is only one square called a piazza in Venice: Piazza San Marco.
Piazzetta
Little city square. There is only one square called a piazzetta in Venice: Piazzetta San Marco, in front of the Doge's Palace.
Sestiere
A district of the city of Venice. There are six of them: Cannaregio, Castello, Dorsoduro, San Marco, San Polo, and Santa Croce (plural: sestieri).
Terrazzo
A common floor material made of crushed pieces of stone, often called graniglia.

A high-ranking official in the Ottoman Empire.
Sultan
The ruler of the Ottoman Empire.
